tei:div.tei:p: (da)༄༅// dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i bka' srung thun mong ma yin pa mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i skor tshang bar bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma mgon po dbyer med la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud la brgyud pa rin chen sna bdun du grags pa'i brgyud pa gsum pa grub thob khyung po rnal 'byor tshul khrims mgon po'am shangs pa gdu bu pa zhes mtshan gyi rnam grangs du ma dang ldan pa'i skyes bu chen po de la/ grub thob rā hu la gup+ta badz+ra gyis bod yul dbus kyi 'phan yul 'jog po rir chos sgo skyel du byon pa'i shangs pa'i gser chos mgon dkar bka' rgya ma'i skor/ rang gis mos pa dang ji ltar rnyed pa dkar chag tu btab ste bsgrigs pa 'di lta ste/ thog mar lugs 'di rgyud gang la brten nas mgon po khros pa'i rgyud le'u brgyad pa la brten par gsungs shing*/ lugs 'dir rgya gzhung lha bu'i snyan brgyud yi ge/ khyung po rnal 'byor pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ bstod pa byin rlabs can/ mgon po'i lo rgyus/ gtor chog mchod 'bul/ skong ba/ rjes gnang gi yi ge rnying pa maṇ+ḍal gtor ma'i zhal gdangs cung zad dang bcas pa/ las tshogs thun mong ma yin pa/ gter bum bca' thabs/ dbang sdud 'khor lo/ sbyin sreg yang bum pa'i zhal gdams rgyas pa/ bstod pa/ rab gnas kyi zhal gdams te/ de rnams yi ge rnying pa'i skor ro// yi ge phyi ma grub mchog tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' grol mchog gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang*/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang*/ bdag gis bris pa'i sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg 'dod don gsol gdab/ brgyud 'debs rnams dang*/ brgyud pa 'di'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs che shos na mo bud+dha'i gsol 'debs rnams bzhugs so// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gdams ngag dbang gi rgyal po bzhugs so// myur mdzad thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gdams ngag dbang gi rgyal po/

dngos grub ma lus pa 'byung ba'i bdag nyid rin po che 'di la don bzhi ste/ lo rgyus dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes so// de la 'di'i lo rgyus rgyas pa che bar gsal la/ bsdus don ni rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rā hu la gup+ta badz+ra gyis bdag khyung po rnal 'byor la brtse ba chen pos dgongs nas/ rgya gar nas yul dbus su skyel du byon pa'i gdams pa'o// 'di'i sbyor ba la gsum las/ dang po bla ma mgon po dbyer med la sogs pa'i dbang zhu/ rgyud smin par byed pa'i bla ma dngos la gsol ba lo zla'i bar du gdab/ gnyis pa 'di rang gi bka' zhu/ tshogs dang gtor ma dbul lo// gsum pa rin po che bsam 'phel 'di'i rdzas bsags pa ni/ bris sku bzhengs la rab gnas gzhung bzhin bya/ maṇ+ḍal mda' gang la dri bzang gis chag chag gdab/ 'bri lugs ni/ dbus lte ba dkar/ pad+ma 'dab bzhi phyogs tshon/ de phan chad dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun/ bris sku bzhengs pa ni/ 'di'i gzhung ltar bzhengs pa'i skya zhal gyi gseb tu/ gri khrag sin+dhu ra/ bla ma bzang po'i gdung*/ rin po che sna tshogs bsags pa skar ma rgyal la byug de'i steng du rtsa sngags stong la sogs pa bgrangs la nus pa can gyi bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar la/ de'i steng du rtsa sngags sid+dhi ma shong tshad bri/ lha bzo dbang po tshang ba/ phyug pa/ sdom pa dang ldan pa zhig gis kha byang du bltas la bri'o// de'i nyin bar dngos grub 'byung ba'i gnad/ rig ma mtshan ldan cig btsal la zas sna tshogs kyi ston mo bya'o// rab gnas spyi dang mthun la/ dngos grub stsol bar gsol ba yun ring du 'debs shing*/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug brgya rtsa la sogs pa gnad yin te bla ma'i zhal las shes so/

yid bzhin nor bu'i rab gnas dang rab gnas bka' rgya ma byed pa yin/ /dngos gzhi ni/ gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan par chas ka rnams legs par bsags te/ stan bde ba la 'dug skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun par bya'o// khyad par sems can thams cad dbul ba'i sdug bsngal dang bral bar bya/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la dgod par bya snyam du bsam pa zhe thag pa nas/ kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin pa bya/ de nas rang gi snying gi dkyil du theg le dmar po rgya sran tsam zhig bsgom/ de'i dkyil 'khor du hūm̐ dkar po dngul chu'i mdog lta bu zhig bsgom/ de gnyis las 'od 'phros pas don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus pas thig le hūm̐ dang bcas pa 'od zer gyi rang bzhin dpag tu med pa 'phro ba zhig bsgom/ de la sems gtad de bsgoms pas de gnyis khrug gis 'dres pa las/ thig le dang hūm̐ gnyis skabs 'dir gzhal yas khang bskyed pa yin gsungs/ rang gi mdun du bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin nor bu sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig bzhad la spyan gsum pa/ phyag drug pa g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug 'phyar ba/ gnyis pas nor bu bsam 'phel bsnams pa/ gsum pa na ḍa ma ru/ g.yon gyi dang pos thod pa na bum pa rin po che sna tshogs kyis bum pa bdud rtsi dang nor bus gang nas lhud lhud yod par bsam/ gang ba brla g.yon pa la brten nas 'dzin pa/ bar pas rtse gsum/ thams cad zhags pa bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ smad rin po che'i chun 'phyang sna tshogs pas mdzes pa'o// zhabs gnyis dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas da lta rang 'byon pa 'dra ba/ 'gro 'phro la bzhugs pa 'dra ba'i 'og na tshogs bdag gnyis mnan te/ kha dang bshang sgo thams cad nas nor bu lhug lhug skyugs pa yod pa gnyis bskyed/ mgon po'i spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang dgos 'dod 'byung ba/

zhal 'dzum me ba zhig bsgom/ mgon po'i thugs kar dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pas lcags kyu g.yon pas thod pa bsnams pa/ zhabs gar stabs su ling nge*/ spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig hrig gzigs pa/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa zhig bskyed/ de'i snying gar chos nyid kyi thig le dmar po 'od 'phro ba cig bskyed/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas mgon po mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dgug ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa phyi mchod lnga dbul/ nang mchod/ spos sbyor/ yid sprul gang rung dbul/ skabs 'dir na mo bud+dha'i gsol 'debs byed/ bsnyen pa'i dus su thig le de la rtsa sngags kyi snying ga'i chos nyid thig le dmar po'i mthar rtsa sngags bye ru'i phreng ba lta bu dmar hram me ba/ mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du 'khor ba de las 'od zer dmar zhing rno ba/ lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dpag med 'phros/ srid zhi'i dge legs thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus nas thig le la thim par bsam/ yang 'od zer dmar po tsha zhing rno ba 'phros/ 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro nor bdag gnod sbyin rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas/ de'i rgyud dbang med du bskul nas/ srid gsum gyi dngos grub hril gyis bsdus nas rang nyid kyi drung du zas nor longs spyod ri rab tsam spungs bar bsam mo// chos 'byung dkar la me ri dmar po'i dbus/ pad+ma dkar gdan 'od stong dmar po'i steng*/ gangs ri ltar dkar zhal gcig phyag drug pa// khyod la rnam dkar dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ khyad par du rgyal po/ phyug po/ drag rgu/ che rgu/ skyes pa bud med la sogs pa'i mi thams cad kyi snying du 'od zer mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin rnams kyi rig pa dang bcas pa zhugs/ mi thams cad kyi shes pa rang dbang med par bskul/

de dag gi dbang du 'ubs kyis 'dus par bsam/ de yang khyad par du gang dbang du bsdu bar 'dod pa de'i snying gi dkyil du mi de'i rnam shes ni ljang gu nya mig tsam zhig yod pa de/ mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin rnams kyi snying ga'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus tsir gyis bzung nas bdag gi dbang du byas par bsam mo// mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin la brten pa'i zab khyad do// gzhan gud du shes/ kyis g.yas phyogs nas bskor bar bsam/ bsnyen sngags chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'bum phrag gsum sngags gzhan dang mi bsre bar bzla'o// sngags ni 'di'o// gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dzaḥ bla ma nag po chen po dang mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i dngos grub stsol/ zhes par 'gyur ro// yig 'bru bcu gsum gnas/ gi gu bzhi/ zhabs kyu gnyis/ khams gsum dbang sdud kyi snying po'o// rtags ni/ bla ma dngos su byon pa dang*/ rig ma mtshan ldan gyi dngos grub ster ba dang*/ mgon po'i zhal mthong ba/ khams gsum gyi sems can la dbang bskur ba la sogs pa rmi lam dang nyams snang dang mngon sum du 'byung*/ de rtags byung nas grub pa thob pa yin pas/ yon tan la tshe ring nad med/ rmi lam zin/ mi nor zas gsum 'phel zhing khams gsum dbang du 'du/ bar do med par sangs rgyas mngon sum du 'byung ngo*// bcom ldan 'das la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ zur gsum khru gang ba/ sha lnga'i rgyan dang*/ zas sna tshogs 'byor tshad bsags la gtor ma'i snod khengs par bshams la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhugs so// de la bris sku gzug go /g.yas su mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ rgyab tu gnod sbyin gyi gtor ma/ g.yon du gzhi bdag gtor ma/ mdun du mchod pa rnam lnga ci 'byor pa bsham/ gnad gcig la 'di'i lung zhu ba dang*/ bca' ga byed dus zas sna bsags la tshogs 'khor byed pa gal che/ 'di zhu ba'i bla ma de la phyag rten gang phul ba de dngos grub kyi thog mar 'byung*/

de lta ma yin na dngos grub yal/ zhes gsungs so// dam tshig gtsang ma'i rnal 'byor pas// tshogs 'khor bshams dang bcas pas 'grub// ces yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyud las gsungs so// des bskyed rim bstan nas/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ rang gi sems nyid thig le dmar por gyur pa de la gtad de/ ji tsam gnas bsgoms pas rang sems gtan la phebs pa yin/ yi ge thig le 'od du yal te song ba'i ngang la ji tsam gnas gyi bar la 'jog bzhag pa'i ngang nas rig pa de rig stong*/ 'gyu ba de 'gyu stong*/ ma sgrib par gsal ba de gsal stong*/ yin min gyi mtha' dang bral bas rmi lam gyi snang ba/ sgyu ma'i rang bzhin zhes pa la ngo sprad/ de rnams rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// de'i steng du nyal 'chag 'gro 'dug gi snang ba yang*/ de kho na bzhin nyams su len pa kho bo khyung po rnal 'byor pa'i spyod tshul lo// sgrub pa 'di la gsol 'debs kho na gal che/ sgrub pa thon pa dang ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ gtor ma che bar dngos grub tu len pa yin/ dam nyams kyi khar mi sbyin/ khyi dang glang la mi sbyin/ gtor ma gtan rnams la mchod bstod gzhung bzhin byas la/ gtor ma nangs nub tsha ba'i dus su/ srog sngags khams gsum dbang sdud kyi gsham du pū dza la khā hi btags la dbul lo// de ma yin pa'i spyan 'dren bstod 'bul/ gtor sngags mgon po'i gzhung bzhin byed pa yin gsungs/ rjes bsngo ba mi dmigs pa'i rgyas 'debs shing bkra shis bka' rgya ma brjod/ bdag khyung po rnal 'byor pas zhal gdams snyan brgyud yi ger bkod/ bla ma mgon po mkha' 'gros bzod par gsol gser chos rnams kyi nang nas mgon po bka' rgya ma 'di rin chen brtson 'grus la gtad do// chig brgyud las ma spel cig 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ ye shes mgon po/ grub chen rā hu la/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor/ mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus/

dbon ston skyer sgang pa/ sangs rgyas gnyan ston/ chos rje ston pa/ sprul sku rin blo/ brag nag pa yon tan rgyal mtshan/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum/ bla ma byams pa dpal/ ār+ya'i mtshan can/ rin chen brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ de las rim par brgyud pa'o// ༈ /mgon dkar gyi bstod pa bzhugs so// mgon po yid bzhin nor bu la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// thugs rje gcig bsdus rje btsun spyan ras gzigs// de yi sprul pa phyag drug mgon po la// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po yid bzhin nor bu thugs rje can// sku mdog gangs ri lta bu 'od zer 'phro// zhal gcig phyag drug zhabs gnyis nor bdag mnan// 'gro ba'i dbul ba sel la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag g.yas dang po rdo rje gri gug bsnams// bar pa yid bzhin nor bus dgos 'dod ster// tha ma ḍa rus mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud// khams gsum dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo// g.yon pas rin chen bum pa sku la gsol// bar pa rtse gsum khams gsum ma lus sgrol// tha ma zhags pas sems can bcings pa 'grol// mgon po thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// sku stod rin chen rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan// sku smad rin chen zar bus rnam par mdzes// phyag zhabs thams cad rin chen nor bus brgyan// 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod ni yid la dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// de yi mod la dbul phongs sdug bsngal sel// 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor zad mi shes pa yis// 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong la bdag bstod do// khyod la mchod cing gus pas bstod byas nas// ji srid byang chub ma thob bar du yang*// mgon po khyod kyi thugs rjes bdag bzung nas// byang chub bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen bsgrub par mdzod// de yi dge bas bdag kyang de bzhin du// 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin skong ba dang*// sems can sangs rgyas sa la 'god pa yi// 'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par mdzod// mgon po yid bzhin nor bu la bstod pa/

dgos 'dod 'byung ba zhes bya ba khyung po rnal 'byor pas sbyar ba rdzogs so// ༈ /yid bzhin nor bu'i lo rgyus bzhugs so// na mo gu ru/ bla ma mai tri pa ko sa bhi k+ṣi'i dur khrod na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ grub chen rā hu las gser srang bdun phul nas/ bod la longs spyod chung bas/ nor sgrub myur ba rtags mtshan che ba'i gdams pa cig zhu zhus pas/ mai tri pa'i zhal nas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i mgon po zhes kyang bya/ shing phung can zhes kyang bya/ tsan+dan gyi mgon po zhes kyang bya/ thugs rje chen po nag po zhes kyang bya/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa zhes kyang bya/ 'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs pa las skyob/ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud/ mi nor zas gsum shugs las 'byung ba/ dgra bgegs thams cad rdul du rlog par byed pa/ bzlog par mi nus pa/ mchog dang thun mong thams cad lo zlas 'grub pa/ mchog bsgrubs pas thun mong zhar las 'byung ba/ thun mong bsgrub pas mchog zhar las 'byung ba zhig yod pa de khyod la sbyin gsungs so// de bla ma la zhu byas pas/ sngon gyi dus na sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi spyan sngar thugs rje chen pos sems bskyed 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'di stong par ma gyur bar du bdag sangs rgyas par ma gyur cig gal te sems bskyed nyams par gyur na mgo bo tshal pa stong du 'gas pa gyur cig ces brjod nas dam bcas te/ ri bo po ta lar nyin mtshan dus drug tu sems can rnams la ye shes kyi gzigs pa 'jug cing*/ gang la gang 'dul gyi don byas par gyur to// de nas lo dpag tu med par sems can gyi don byas te/ sems can mang po thar grol byung las che snyam nas gzigs pas/ sems can gyi khams la 'phel 'grib med pa'i steng du snyigs mar song bas nyon mongs pa rags pa/ gdug pa cher song 'dug pas/ da ni bdag gis sems can re 'ga' tsam yang sgrol bar mi nus par 'dug snyam nas/

sems bskyed btang ba dang*/ dbu tshal pa stong du gas par gyur to// de na snang ba mtha' yas byon nas/ rigs kyi bu de lta bu'i sems bskyed las gzhol ba ni shin tu ma legs pas/ de'i bshags pa la sems bskyed sngar las rgya che ba zhig zungs shig gsungs nas/ dbu stong du gas pa zhal bcu gcig tu byin gyis brlabs so// da ni sngar gyi sems bskyed las rgya che ba med cing*/ de'i cha gcig kyang ngas ma nus pas/ de bas rgya che ba ni gcig kyang med do snyam nas/ zhag bdun brgyal bar gyur to// de nas brgyal ba de sangs pa dang*/ da ni snyigs ma'i sems can tshe thung la bar chad mang ba/ rkyen dbang 'ba' zhig tu 'gro ba/ longs spyod chung bas 'tsho ba dman pa/ sgrub long med par bar chad kyi dbang du 'gro ba/ dam tshig mi bsrung ba/ zlog pa dang nang dme byed pa/ chos byed phal cher bar do'i 'jigs pa las mi thar bar gzigs nas/ yun ring mi dgos par zhal mthong ba/ gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis 'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob pa/ mi nor zas gsum shugs las 'byung ba/ bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad skad cig gis brlag par mdzad pa/ mchog dang thun mong lo zlas 'grub pa'i dbang gi rgyal po lta bu'i khro bor gyur nas sems can gyi don bya'o snyam nas/ thugs ka nas hūm̐ mthing nag gcig byung ba las/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ skye 'gro'i re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bur gyur pa dang*/ sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos so// de nas sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpag tu med pas mgrin gcig tu bsdebs te/ rigs kyi bu sems can gyi re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba'i spyod pa 'di shin tu legs so// sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba las byung ba/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed pos nyid yi mthu dang ldan par bya'o// gsang ba'i khro bo dbang gi rang bzhin dang ldan par bya'o// de nyid kyi zhi ba dang rgyas par 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las su sprul pa las byung ba'i gnod sbyin dang*/

srin po dang*/ ma mo dang bcas pa rnams kyis las sna tshogs grub par 'gyur ro// de nyid tshul bzhin du bsgrub pa dang mchod pa dang*/ dran pas dngos grub ma lus ster bar 'gyur ro// sgrub pa nyid nas byin gyis brlab bo// de nyid kyis dngos su zhal ston par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// de nyid bsgrub pa'i dus su/ nas rjen 'thags kyi gtor ma dang*/ spos sbyor ma chad pa gyis/ khyi nag po la rdo mi brdeg yid ches par gyis la bla ma dang dbyer med du bsgom/ de ltar byas pas 'tsho ba sbyor zhing zhal dngos su ston/ 'di chig brgyud lags// ༈ /mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i gtor ma'i cho ga bzhugs// a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ kam̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag du ma dang grub pa'i gtor ma zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum/ mdun bskyed/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dngul chu'i mdog can 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba las mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag drug spyan gsum pa/ phyag drug g.yas kyi dang po na gri gug bar pa na yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ tha ma na ḍa ma ru drag tu 'khrol ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na thod pa'i nang du bum pa rin po che sna tshogs kyis gang ba brla g.yon pa la brten te 'dzin pa/ bar pa na rtse gsum/ tha ma na lcags kyu bsnams pa/ sku stod la rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan cing*/ sku smad la rin po che'i zar bu dang chun 'phyang du mas mdzes pa/ zhabs gnyis dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas da lta rang 'byon pa 'dra ba/

'gro 'phro la tshom ste bzhugs pa 'dra ba'i 'og na tshogs bdag kha gshang thams cad nas nor bu skyugs pa gnyis mnan/ mgon po'i spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang dbang gi rgyal po yid bzhin gyi nor bu bsnams pa dgos 'dod 'byung ba 'dzum dang ldan pa/ mgon po'i thug kar dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ lcags kyu dang thod pa bsnams pa gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig hrig gzigs pa khams gsum dbang du sdud pa cig bskyed/ de'i thugs ka na chos nyid kyi thig le dmar po 'od 'phro ba/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal nas mgon po mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ gu ru ma hā kā la dang*/ k+ṣiṃ nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs kyis spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ chos 'byung dkar la me ri dmar ba'i dbus// pad dkar mdangs ldan 'od stong phyogs bcur 'phro// gangs ri ltar dkar zhal gcig phyag drug pa// khyed la rnam dkar dang bcas gus phyag 'tshal// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ tsan+dan ljon pa 'khrigs pa'i dur khrod nas// dri bzhon gyis bskyod sprin dkar phung po bzhin// phyag na pad+mo'i rnam rol bstan srung mchog /mgon dkar 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs gnas 'dir gshegs// lhan skyes bla ma yid bzhin nor bu yi// bka' sgrub phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dbang du sdud// rnal 'byor mchog la dngos grub myur stsol bzhes shig= gter chen bum pa stong gsum gang= sna tshogs nor gyis gtams pa 'di= lha chen= bzhes shig= bdud bzhi tshar gcod gri gug ni// gnam lcags las grub rno ngar ldan// ral gri gser gyi yu bar bcas// nyi khyim chu srin kha nas 'thon// lha chen= bzhes shig= stong gsum yid bzhin 'dod rgu stsol// tshe gcig sangs rgyas ster yang nus// bsam don mtha' dag lta ci smos// nor bu dbang gi rgyal po 'di// lha chen= bzhes shig= gsang ba'i rnga chung cang te'u// lha mi dbang du rab sdud cing*// srung ma las la skul byed 'di// lha chen= bzhes= mtshan ldan ka li bdud rtsis bkang*// gter chen bum pa nor gyis bkang*// khams gsum longs spyod dang mtshungs 'di// lha chen= bzhes= dug gsum kun rtog rtsad nas gcod// sku gsum 'chi med dngos grub ster// rtsa gsum ba dan dang bcas pa// lha chen= bzhes= rā ga'i lcags kyu nus par ldan// snang ba dbang sdud nor bu 'di// lha chen= bzhes= rin chen nor bu do shal bcas// rin chen phreng ba drwa bas mdzes// pad+ma'i chun 'phyang g.yer kha'i sbrel// stag sham sna tshogs dar dang bcas// lha chen= bzhes= mdor na phyi yi snang ba ru// mdzes dang dga' dang bde ba dang*// rin thang med pa'i mchod rdzas kun// dmigs med sgyu ma'i ngang nas 'bul// sgyu ma'i ngang du bzhes par mdzod// longs spyod rgya chen 'phel ba'i phyir// tshogs dang gtor ma spyan gzigs dang*// 'bru dang nor dang longs spyod rnams// ci 'byor gus pas bshams pa dang*// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin ni// dpag med mkha' khyab dang bcas pa// dmigs bral dmigs pas rab bcad nas// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel phyir du// lha chen mgon po khyod la 'bul// ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang*// yid bzhin mgon po'i= thugs rje'i gter chen= badz+ra ḍā ki'i= rat+na ḍā ki'i= pad+ma ḍā ki'i= karma ḍā ki'i=

bud+dha ḍā ki'i= grangs med ḍā ki'i= dpa' bo'i tshogs kyi= dpa' mo'i tshogs kyi= bstan srung yongs kyi= dam can rgya mtsho'i= nor lha gnod sbyin= khyed kyi thugs dam bskangs gyur nas// rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas dang*// rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi// nad gdon bar chad mi mthun phyogs// zhi ba'i ḍā kis sel ba dang*// zhi ba'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor kun// rgyas mdzad rgyas pa'i ḍā ki yis// rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// khams gsum dbang sdud ḍā ki yis// khams gsum srid gsum ma lus pa// dbang du 'du zhing brtan pa yi// dngos grub myur ba nyid du stsol// sna tshogs ḍā kis sna tshogs kyi// las rnams mtha' dag grub par mdzod// bud+dha ḍā kis 'jigs med kyi// sku gsum chen po'i dngos grub stsol// mdor na mgon po 'khor bcas kyis// brten cing bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor gyi// bsam pa'i don 'di grub par mdzod// brten ni lha chen mgon po brten// mchod ni yid bzhin mgon po mchod// bsgrub ni gu ru mgon po bsgrub// bgrang ni mgon po'i rtsa sngags bgrang*// don ni sems can don du bsam// da ni thugs rjes myur du gzigs// sngags 'chang dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*// dgra dang chom rkun 'joms pa dang*// mi mthun phyogs rnams bzlog pa dang*// bsam don ma lus 'grub par mdzod// tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa dang*// dpal 'byor snyan grags rgyas pa dang*// longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang*// lo thog 'bad med 'byung ba dang*// 'bru dang zas nor 'phel ba dang*// rkang bzhi mtha' dbus rgyas pa dang*// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub gyur nas// 'chi med longs sku 'grub pa yi// phrin las da lta 'grub par mdzod// dngos grub da lta stsol ba dang*// byin gyi myur du rlob pa dang*// lha chen khyed kyi zhal mthong shog

/gnas dang yul dang yon bdag 'di// bde zhing 'bru rnams 'phel ba dang*// bang mdzod nor gyis rab gang zhing*// phyugs dang lo tog phun tshogs nas// gter chen dpal la rab spyod pa'i// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag nyid gyur cig /mdor na yon bdag 'khor bcas rnams// lus sems bde zhing mdangs stobs ldan// longs spyod 'phel zhing bsam don 'grub// sku lnga 'chi med ye shes sku// nor bu'i dpal la spyod par shog /

de nas rin chen mdzes pa dang*/ 'dzam gling ma la 'jug gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dzaḥ lha chen mgon po ma hā kā la dang*// yid bzhin mgon po ḍā ki'i 'khor gyis bskor// bstan srung rgya mtsho nor lha gnod sbyin bcas// dkar phyogs dga' ba'i gzhi bdag 'khor bcas rnams// zag med bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /bcud ldan zas kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /rin chen rnam lnga'i gser skyems 'di= /btung ba sna tshogs phud gtor 'di= /'bru dang sman gyi mchod pa 'di= /nad gdon bar chad ma lus zhi ba dang*// bsam don ma lus myur du 'grub gyur nas// longs spyod 'dod rgu dpal la spyod par shog/ ༈ /mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang la/ dkyil 'khor dang gtor ma dang mchod pa rnams legs par bshams nas// slob ma rnams gral la 'khod de/ tshogs bsags pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal dbul/ de nas 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa la sogs pa'i chos bshad/ de nas skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/ bla mas chos skyong 'khor bcas mchod bstod kyis mnyes par byas la/ bla ma rje btsun kha sar+pā ṇir dmigs pa'i thugs kar yid bzhin gyi nor bu gzhung bzhin bskyed pa'i thugs kar mkha' 'gro ma bskyed/ de'i thugs kar thig le dmar po'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po dngul chu'i mdog lta bu cig bsgom/ slob mas mos 'dun drag pos bla ma rin po ches bdag la bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin nor bu'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ slob ma tha mal du gnas pa'i snying gi dkyil du thig le dmar po gcig bsgom/ de'i steng du thig le dkar po cig bsgom/ de nas 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las mgon po ji lta bar bskyed pa'i thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du thig le dmar po'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po dang bcas bsgom du bcug la/

slob mas mos 'dun drag pos/ bcom ldan yid bzhin nor bu yi// sku yi rjes gnang dbang bskur ni// bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod la/ dpon slob gnyis ka'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal nas bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas slob ma rnams la sib sib thim par bsam/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod nas/ bla ma rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod la gsol ba btab la/ bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin nor bu khyod kyis rdo rje 'dzin pa 'di zhes bya ba'i phyi bzhin rgyug cing 'brangs la/ tshe dang ldan pa 'di bya ba'i skabs dang sbyar/ da nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du phrin las gang dgos sgrubs shig ces brjod do// gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ bcom ldan yid bzhin nor bu yi// gsung gi dbang bskur rjes gnang ni// bdag la byin gyis brlabs tu gsol// zhes bla ma la gsol ba btab la/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas snying po yig 'bru bcu gsum po slob ma'i snying ga nas bcug nas/ hūm̐ dkar po la 'khor bar dmigs nas/ rjes zlos gsum bya/ rtsa sngags sid+dhi ma 'dren/ bka' bsgo ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin nor bu khyod kyis rdo rje 'dzin pa 'di zhes bya ba'i phyi bzhin du rgyug cing 'brangs la da nas byang chub ma thob bar zhes pa gong bzhin bya/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ gsol ba gdab/ bcom ldan yid bzhin nor bu yi// thugs kyi dbang bskur rjes gnang ni// bdag la byin gyis brlabs tu gsol// bla ma'i thugs ka'i pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ dkar la 'tsher ba'i dbus su sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro rnams bzhugs pa bla ma'i shangs g.yas nas thon/

slob ma'i sna bug g.yon nas zhugs pas snying gar thim par bsams nas bka' bsgo/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// yang phrin las kyi gsol gdab byas la/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i mkha' 'gro lnga las kyang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ tshogs bdag gi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer 'phros pas nor lha rnams dang*/ gzhan yang 'jig rten pa'i mthu che ba rnams dang*/ rang gi bsgrub bya de bkug nas tshogs bdag la bstim mo// bla ma'i rtsa 'khor lo bzhi'i mkha' 'gro rnams dbu ma'i nang nas yar song bas/ smin phrag gi mkha' 'gro lnga la thim/ de rnams las mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rigs de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa dbang du bsdus/ slob ma'i smin phrag gi mkha' 'gro lnga la thim par bsam mo// thod pa'i nang gi bum pa rin po ches khengs nas lud pas thod pa'ang khengs nas chil li li lud pas rang dang sems can thams cad la dgos 'dod char bzhin babs par bsam/ gtor ma zur brgyad pa'i tha ma mtheb kyu dang*/ zan ril bu sum brtsegs kyis bskor ba de la mgon por bskyed/ de la ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya'o// rjes gnang gi dmigs pa thon pa dang*/ gtor ma de slob ma'i mgor bzhag la/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med slob ma'i mgo thog tu byon cing*/ chem chem 'ur 'ur byon par bsam/ snang srid thams cad dbang du 'dus pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro thams cad dgyes par bsam/ maṇ+ḍal ni chos 'byung dkar po me ri dmar po/ khyams phyogs mdog dkyil gyi hūm̐ dmar po chos 'byung gi gdengs ka'i zur la bstan pa bri'o// de'i steng du maṇ+ḍal mañdzi'i steng du gtor ma bzhag la mchod rdzas kyis bskor/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma dkar po 'dab bzhi'i lte bar nyi ma dang bcas pa/ mtha' skor me ris bskor ba bri/ lte bar hūm̐ dkar po bri/ lugs gcig go/ ༈ /mgon po yid bzhin nor bu'i las tshogs thun mong ma yin pa bzhugs/

bla ma dam pa rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// las kha tshar 'di la zhi ba nor du sgrub pa dang*/ drag po mthu ru sgrub pa gnyis las/ 'dir myur mdzad ces pa la rten nas zhi ba nor du sgrub pa'o// de la dang po dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ bum pa bca' ba dang*/ rdzas rnams bsag pa dang*/ lha bskyed pa dang*/ bsnyen pa bskyal ba dang*/ rtags thon pa'o// de la dkyil 'khor bri ba gzhung ltar bya/ bum pa bcas pa dkyil 'khor bris pa'i steng du mañdzi la sogs pa'i khar bzhag gzungs thag nang rdzas sogs dang ldan par bya/ mchod gtor rgyas par bsham/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las bum pa nang gzhal yas khang du bsam/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan steng du hrīḥ'am gaḥ'i yig 'bru la 'od 'phros/ 'gro ba'i don byas yig 'bru la thim/ hrīḥlas mgon po dkrong gis bskyed/ de yang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ g.yas dang po na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che/ gnyis pa na ne'u le/ gsum pa na bum pa/ g.yon dang po na gcod pa'i 'khor lo/ gnyis pa na ne'u le/ gsum pa na 'gugs pa'i phyag rgyas mthe bong dang srin lag sprad pa'o// de nas ye shes pa dgug dbang bskur rdzogs// byang chub sems kyis thog drangs la// yan lag bdun pa rdzogs par bya// de yi thugs kar hrīḥlas ni// sngags kyi sham bur bcas pas bskor// gaḥ'am hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas// spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstim// gzungs thag gzung la snying po bzla// lha yi thugs dang rgyud bskul nas// 'od byung bum pa'i rdzas la phog /rin po che dang bdud rtsir gyur// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi// dgos 'dod ma lus 'od kyis bkug /nor gyi char pa babs byas te// bum pa'i nang du thim par bsam// oṃ ma hā kā la ga ṇa pa ta ye swā hā/ zhes bya ba yi snying po ni// smra bcad khams kyis thub tshad bgrang*// gsol ba 'debs pa 'di bzhin bya// jo bo gzi ldan bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yis// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa la// sbyin pa yongs su rdzogs bya'i phyir// 'byor pa chen po'i dngos grub stsol// zhes ni lan bdun gsol ba gdab// rtags ni 'di ltar shes par bya// sgrub pa byed pa'i dus su ni// nor bzang 'bul ba byung na bzang*// zhal mthong ba ni rab yin no// rmi lam rtags ni 'di ltar ro// me tog mthor dang bcas pa dang*// gzhan gyis zas nor 'bul ba dang*// 'phying pa gos gsar sbyin pa dang*// chu yi longs spyod byed pa dang*// go cha dmag mi rmi na bzang*// sgrub pa thon pa'i dus su ni// bum pa nas ni rang nyid bza'// dngos grub blang ba'i don yang yin// ma 'grub lan gsum bskyar bar bya// dngos grub 'byung ba'i rdzas rnams la// brten cing sgrub la brtson par bya// dkon mchog gsum la mchod par bya// dbul po rnams kyi don yang bya// rang la zhen pa med par bya// deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// kho yis yon bdag byed par 'gyur// 'di yi yig sna yod pa tsam gyis bang mdzod 'phel/

'bru 'khrung*/ lo legs 'ong*/ bsam pa 'grub bo// gtor ma che ba gtar gzung*/ gtor chung zhag re la nyi shu rtsa re gtang*/ skar ma rgyal 'dzom pa la sgrub pa byed pa'i dus su'o// sgrub pa'i dus ni yar ngo'i tshes brgyad nas gnam stong gi bar la bya'o// sa ma ya*// ༈ /mgon po yid bzhin nor bu'i bum gter bca' thabs bzhugs/ mgon po gzi ldan thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// bum pa kha yangs shing mchu yongs su grags pa dang ldan pa/ ma chag pa/ ma gas pa/ lhan pa med pa/ dri ma dang bral zhing gtsang ba'i nang du/ nas dkar mo sad la sogs pa'i skyon dang bral zhing*/ sbun sog dang sran ma dang*/ rdo la sogs pa gcig kyang med cing phyug po'i bang mdzod nas byung ba'am/ yang na 'bras dkar mo ma grus pa ste/ de gnyis gang yang rung bas khengs par bkang*/ de'i steng du gser/ dngul/ bye ru/ mu men/ g.yu rnying*/ zangs/ pad+ma rā ga dung la sogs pa rin po che rnyed tshad/ gos dar bzang po'i ras ma rigs mi gcig pa rnyed tshad/ ja dkar nag dang*/ sha/ mar/ bu ram/ rgun 'brum la sogs pa'i zas sna/ a ru ra rnam rgyal lam/ ma rnyed na'ang gzhan gser mdog bzang po dang*/ bzang drug dang*/ ga bur/ a ga ru/ tsan+dan dkar dmar/ dbang lag la sogs gzhug cing*/ de dag ni dbus su bum pa'i mgrin pa dang*/ lto ba'i mtshams las cung zad mtho ba tsam du/ mgon po gzi ldan gyi sku tsakli rab gnas tshul bzhin du byas pa bum pa'i mchu la brten cing*/ bum rdzas kyi nang du nub par bzhugs su bcug bum pa'i mchu rang la bstan/ zhag re la thun bzhir bum pa'i nang du mgon po bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug gsol ba drag tu gdab/ gtor ma che ba'i nang du gtor chung bstab/ gtor ma che ba ni nas dkar so gtsang ma'i rjen phye btags la/ dpal bshos zur gsum khru gang ba/ mar dang*/ sbrang rtsi dang*/ bu ram gyis brgyan cing rtse mor mar gyi nor bu 'bar ba dang*/ mdun phyogs kyi logs la mar dkar po chen po bris pa/

mtheb kyu brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bcad kha nang du bstan nas bskor ba/ snod zangs kyi ka ṭo ra la sogs pa/ gas chag dang*/ bug pa dang*/ lhan pa la sogs med pa chen po bya/ tsakli dang*/ me long dang*/ dar dkar dmar mthing gsum gyis mda' rgod sgro ma mes ma reg pa la brgyan pa'i mda' dar gzug thun dang po la gtor chung cig bla ma yi dam la 'bul/ de ma gtogs thun bzhi po re re la gtor chung lnga lnga mgon po rang la dbul/ gtor ma che ba dang po nas snod khengs pa/ mtheb kyu snod phyir ma thal ba bya/ gtor chen mgon por bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug de dang bum pa'i nang gi mgon po dbyer med du mos nas/ gtor chung dbul/ gtor chung ni gtor ma che ba'i mdun du snod gzhan bzhag pa'i nang du 'bul du rung*/ gtor ma byin rlabs gzhung bzhin no// gtor chung 'bul ba'i tshe re re lag pa g.yas pas bzung ste/ rtsa sngags sid+dhi ma yi ge bcu gsum gyi mthar/ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags nas dbul/ sgrub pa thon kha'i thun tha ma la/ gtor ma che ba'i mgon po nam mkha' la bzhugs su gsol nas/ gtor ma che ba legs par byin gyis brlabs te dbul/ thun thams cad la'ang gtor ma che ba mtheb kyu re res gso/ sgrub pa'i bar la mtshams dam par bcad/ gzhan la gsang*/ ngag bcad/ sgrub rdzas phyir mi 'don/ stan mi sprug phyag dar mi bya/ dbang sdud kyi 'khor lo bris nas rab gnas byas pa skud pa dmar pos dkris te/ sgrub pa'i bar bum pa'i mgul par btags la/ sgrub pa thon du nye ba'i thun tha ma'i tshe/ gtor ma'i mgon po nam mkhar bteg pa de la gtor ma phul tshar nas 'khor lo la bstims te 'khor lo rang gi lugs la bcangs pas/ gang 'dod pa dbang du 'gyur ro// sgrub pa thon nas thod pa dum bu gcig la mtshan ldan gyi nang du sngar gyi bum rdzas rnams nas dang bcas pas bkang ba'i nang du bum pa'i nang gi sku tsakli'i zhal thod pa'i dpral bar bstan nas/

sku nas la nub par byas te bcug pa rang gi nye ba'i khang pa'am/ rang gi mchod khang du gzhan gyis mi mthong bar bzhugs su bcug pa'i mdun du 'dzin gtor bcas te nub re bzhin gso zhing dbul/ gzhan bum pa'i rdzas kyi nas sam 'bras lhag ma rang kho nas longs spyad cing*/ sgrub pa'i gtor ma'ang rang kho nas dngos grub du blang*/ sgrub rdzas rnams dang po 'tshol ba'i tshe dam nyams dang grib can gyi lag nas byung ba dang ma 'dres par bya zhing bsang sbyangs legs par byas nas/ gu gul gyis bdugs te bum pa'i nang du gzhug par bya zhing*/ chang phud dang*/ gtor phye ma 'bags pa gal che'o// zhal shes zhib par yi ger bkod pa yin pas/ ches shin tu gsang bar bya'o// dpe su la'ang mi bstan no// sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu// ༈ /dbang sdud kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag zab mo bzhugs/ dbang sdud kyi 'khor lo bri ba ni/ bri ba'i gzhi dar dang ras dmar po/ gro ga dang shog bu gang yang rung ba'o// dus ni skar ma rgyal 'dzom pa'i yar ngo'i tshes brgyad dam bcu bzhi'i snga dror/ kha nub la bltas te/ rang nyid mgon po yid bzhin nor bu'i thugs kar dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa bsgom la/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bcug ste/ bzlas pa cung zhig bya/ mgon po'i nga rgyal la gnas pas bri bar bya'o// rdzas ni gur gum/ gi haṃ/ sin+dhu ra rang byung*/ rgya skyegs/ tsan+dan dmar po rnams kyi khu ba bsres pa'i mtshal gyis bri bar bya ste/ de'ang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte bar hrīḥ de'i mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dzaḥ che ge mo ming yig bri wā shaṃ ku ru hoḥzhes pa bri/ rtsibs brgyad la hrīḥ shong na sngags de nyid kha nang du bstan pa bri/ mu khyud la ā li kā li g.yas skor du bri/ mdun du bzhag ste mchod gtor bsham/ mgon po'i thugs kar dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa gzhung bzhin bskyed la ye shes pa spyan drangs gzhug

mchod gtor bshams pa phul nas/ thugs ka'i mkha' 'gro ma mgon po'i bshang lam mam/ shangs bug g.yas nas thon te/ 'khor lo yig 'bru rnams dang dbyer med du 'dres par mos nas/ sngags spel tshig med pa stong rtsa brgyad dam/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i me tog gtor/ brtan bzhugs/ bsgrub bya'i rnam shes bkug nas 'khor lo'i ming yig la bstim pa lan mang du byas nas 'khor lo dril te/ gzhon nu ma ma nyams pas bkal ba'i skud pa dmar pos 'khor lo mi mthong bar dkris nas lus la bcang ba'am/ 'dzin gtor gyi mda' dar la gdags/ zhag re bzhin spel tshig dang bcas pa'i bzlas pa ma chag par bya'o// ches zab pa'i man ngag go /gsang ngo*// rgya rgya rgya/ sa ma ya// sa ma ya ma ti kra ma na mo// dang por byin gyis brlab pa'i nag po chen po'i bsnyen pa grangs tshad rdzogs par bya'o// de nas mgon po yid bzhin nor bu'i bsnyen sngags sid+dhi ma bsnyen pa grangs thams cad tshang ba/ dngos sam rmi lam gyi rtags gang yang rung ba thon nges par bya/ de nas mgon po gzi ldan dang*/ bsnyen sngags gha sa ta dang*/ rdzas bum pa dang*/ 'khor lo la sogs pa la brten pa'i sgrub pa dang las sbyor rnams nyams su len pa la 'jug pa yin no// gtor ma lha ru bskyed pa yin na/ gtor ma'i logs la mar gyis hūm̐ bri/ lha ru mi bskyed pa'i 'dzin gtor nar ma sogs la mar dang bu ram gyis nor bu byed kyi/ hūm̐ bri ba ma yin no// sa ma pa thā mi thi// ༈ /yid bzhin nor bu'i sbyin sreg bzhugs/ mgon po 'di'i sbyin sreg la gnyis las/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg byed na/ thab khung la sogs pa thams cad spyi dang mthun par byas nas/ me tog ser po la sogs pa bsreg rdzas dang*/ mgon po yid bzhin nor bu thugs ka'i mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas thab nang du 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i thugs ka'i me gru gsum gyi dbus su bskyed nas ye shes pa gzhug pa sogs bya/

'das pa'i me lha la bsreg rdzas brgya rtsa brgyad re 'bul ba dang*/ sngags ni/ gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni na sid+dhi dzaḥ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi pa'i 'khor dang longs spyod dang nor dang 'bru dang*/ rin po che la sogs pa 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes sngags re dang rdzas re spel la dbul/ de nas 'das pa'i me lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ 'jig rten pa la lhag ma phul nas/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur pa sogs cho ga spyi dang 'dra'o// dbang sdud la zla gam dmar po bris pa'am brtsigs pa la/ bsreg rdzas sogs cho ga gzhan thams cad dbang gi sbyin sreg spyi dang mthun pa la/ mgon po'i thugs ka'i mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas par bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i tshe/ gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dzaḥ che ge mo wā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes sngags re rdzas re spel nas 'bul ba'i tshe dus su thugs ka'i mkha' 'gro ma las de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ bsgrub bya'i snying ga'am/ bha ga nas lcags kyus bkug ḍa ma ru'i sgras sems myos par byas te rang dbang med par bkug nas/ bdag gi rkang pa'i drung du bzhag par bsam pa yang yang bya'o// thug pa bskol ba'i me la yang bskyed chog mdor bsdus byas nas tshwa dang phye mar la sngags dang bcas nas cung zad re 'bul ba'i sbyin sreg bya bar yang gsungs so// // ༈ /yid bzhin nor bu'i gter bum bca' ba'i gdams pa zab mo bzhugs/ na mo gu ru/ chos skyong gi bum pa bca' ba'i thabs ni/ dang po bum pa so btang ba/ ma spyad pa/ tshad bre gang shong ba yan chod/ mgrin par bkra shis rdzas brgyad bris pa'i nang du/ chos skyong gi sku gzugs dang*/ rtsa ba'i sngags sid+dhi ma'i mjug 'dod pa'i don zhu ba'i tshig rten 'di la gnas par mdzad du gsol/ gnas 'dir skye bo thams cad gus pas 'du zhing 'byor pa thams cad chu bo'i tshogs bzhin 'du bar mdzad du gsol/

zhes pa dang*/ srungs shig la sogs pa btags la de 'dra ba mthing shog la gser gyis bris pa dang*/ ga bur dang*/ bu ram dang*/ tsan+dan dmar po/ rang byung*/ gi ham la sogs pas bris pa phyogs bzhi nas dbus kyi sku gzugs la kha bstan te bzhag sku rab gnas legs par byas pa'i zhal bum pa'i mchu la bstan/ bum rdzas rin po che sna tshogs pa dang*/ sman sna tshogs pa dang*/ 'bru sna tshogs pa dang*/ dar zab sna tshogs dang*/ mngar gsum la sogs pa'i zas sna tshogs pa dang*/ mgon po'i dam rdzas sna tshogs bcug la khengs par dgang*/ lug dar ma'i sog pa g.yas pa'i bal rtsi med pas kha bcad/ de'i steng du mthing shog la gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram bris pas kha bcad/ de nas tshon sna lnga'i skud pas mgul pa bcings la/ de'i rjes kha'i steng nas rgya gram du bcing ngo*// de nas rang gi gnas khang gi mdzod dam/ dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang gi khyams kyi nang la sogs pa'i gyang la sogs la/ thog mtshams las cung zad dma' bar khung bu gru bzhi pa/ dpangs su khru gang ba byas pa'i nang la zhal zhal legs po bya/ mtshal gyis byug sin+dhu re'i g.yung drung ris phyogs bzhir bri/ de'i nang du mthing shog la gser gyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa gding*/ de'i steng du bum pa dar sna lnga'i tshon skud sna lngas rgya gram du bcings nas/ zhal khang pa'i phugs sam gtsang khang sogs la bstan la bzhag de'i steng nas dar gyi gur dbub/ mdun gyi mar gyi gtor ma nor bus brgyan pa bzhag rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas lho phyogs bsil ba'i tshal nas mgon po spyan drangs nas bum pa'i nang du thim pa dang*/ gsol ba btab nas brtan par bzhugs pa lan brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ lnga bcu'am nyer gcig bya/ mchod bstod gtor ma dbul/ rang dang bum nang gi mgon po'i thugs ka'i mkha' 'gro ma las de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa 'phros pas lho phyogs bsil ba'i tshal nas lha dang mi'i rin po che dang*/

'byor pa'i khyad par ci yod pa bkug ste/ bum pa'i nang gi rin po che la sogs pa rnams la thim pa yang yang bsgoms nas bum pa'i mgul pa la gzungs thag btags nas bzung ste/ rtsa sngags sid+dhi ma stong rtsa bzla/ bum pa'i nang gi nor zas rnams lud/ mgon po'i phyag gi bum pa dang thod pa nas kyang lud/ ne'u le dang tshogs bdag gi kha bshang nas kyang rin po che lhug lhug lud nas/ gnas khang dang gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i nang thams cad spyad pas zad mi shes pa tsam du khengs par bsams pa bkra shis bya/ bum pa gtor ma dang bcas pa mi bsgul/ 'dag pa'i sa gru bzhi la g.yung drung ris bris pas kha bcad/ phyi nas zhal zhal byas te mi mngon par bya/ de ltar byas na gnas der 'byor pa zad mi shes pa 'byung ste/ thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag zab pa yin cing*/ zhal shes rnams kyang yi ger bkod pa yin pas/ dpe gzhan la mi bstan par ches cher gdams par bya/ sa ma ya rgya rgya// ༈ /nag po chen po'i bstod pa chos dbyings spros bral ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ chos dbyings spros dang bral ba'i rang bzhin las// gdug pa 'dul zhing bar chad srung ba'i phyir// 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed pa'i rnam 'phrul gyis// thugs dam rjes su skyong la bdag bstod do// sgeg cing dpa' gtum mi gdug gzugs 'chang ba// 'jigs pa'i cha lugs bskal pa'i mun rim bzhin// mthing nag rab 'bar rnam 'gyur ci yang ston// khro gtum gshin rje'i gshed la bdag bstod do// rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung ba yi// hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyis log 'dren snying rab 'gas// ha la ha la'i gad mos 'jig rten g.yo// rab brjid 'brug sgra sgrogs la bdag bstod do// snying rje rngam zhing zhi ba'i rang bzhin las// sgrib gnyis bag chags spros pa'i phyogs las dben// 'gro 'ong skye ba'i 'pho 'gyur med pa'i klong*// dus gsum rnam par gzigs la bdag bstod do// gang gis khyed la gus pas gsol btab na// mchog dang thun mong dpal 'byor dgos 'dod kun// dbang gi rgyal po las kyang lhag par 'gyur// yon tan mi zad gter la bdag bstod do// bdud bzhi dregs pa gdug pa'i tshogs pa la// gnam lcags ral gri gangs ri'i char phab nas// skad cig nyid la bsgral nas rjes su 'dzin// phrin las thogs pa med la bdag bstod do// gtor ma rgya chen 'bul gyi mi dge bshags// nyid kyi zag med dge la rjes yi rang*// 'gro ba'i don du bka' sgrub skyong ba la// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par bzhugs gsol 'debs// sa bcu'i mnga' bdag byang chub sems dpa' khyod// bstan pa bsrung zhing 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir// sngon gyi thugs dam zhal gyis bzhes pa rnams// dran par mdzod la yud tsam bdag la dgongs// thub pa'i bstan pa snum zad mar me bzhin// dam pa rnams ni nyin skar rus sbal spu// blun po bkur zhing mkhas btsun ring du bsrings// yang dag chos nub chos min dar ba'i dus// lam zhugs phal cher bdud kyi zhags pas zin// khyed kyi phrin las nus pa zad dam ci// kye ma bdag gis ma bzod zhus pa'i don// rdo rje gtum mchog khyod la gsol 'debs kyi// phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog

/nyin mo'i pad+mo bzhin du rgyas pa dang*// bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i skyes mchog dam pa rnams// sku khams bzang zhing don gnyis mthar phyin mdzod// yul khams kun tu dus ngan 'thab rtsod zhi// nad dang nyer 'tshe mu ge med pa dang*// sems can thams cad bde skyid ldan gyur nas// myur du srid zhi'i mtha' las grol bar mdzod// bla ma'i sku dgra bstan pa'i dkrugs shing byed// bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i ma rungs rnams// rtsad nas bcad nas ma nor lam mchog tu// gzhug cing don chen 'grub pa'i las mdzod cig /mgon po mchog la bstod cing gsol btab pas// bdag ni sgyu lus 'di la brten nas su// sa lam mthar phyin phrin las rnam bzhi yis// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting nas skem par shog /nag po chen po'i bstod pa chos dbyings spros bral ma zhes bya ba 'di/ kun dga' 'od kyis rmog lcog 'od gsal gyi gzhal yas khang du chos skyong dang zhal mjal dus bstod cing gsol ba btab pa yin no// ༈ /yid bzhin nor bu'i rab gnas bzhugs/ rab gnas spyi dang mthun pa'am/ 'di'i sgos kyi rab gnas bya/ yid la 'dod rgu bde blag tu stsol ba dang*/ dngos grub thams cad tshul bzhin du stsol ba'i gsol ba yun ring du ye shes pa la gdab/ ye shes pa gzhug pa brgya rtsa la sogs pa byed pa man ngag yin no// bris sku bzhengs pa'i gnad do// mgon po'i rab gnas zhes kyang zer/ rab gnas bka' rgya ma zhes kyang zer la/ rab gnas gang byed kyang thog mar bsnyen pa gal che bas/ rang rje btsun ma sgrol mar bskyed/ mdun gyi me tog kyang sgrol mar bskyed/ de la sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa bstim zhing*/ rten 'brel snying po bzla/ spyi'i bsnyen pa'o// me tog gtor tsa na/ lha gang yin par bskyed nas/ lha la thim par bsam zhing*/ 'di gnad che ba yin gsungs/ tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par byed pa'i 'dod lha lta bu'i rab gnas byed na/

me tog rin chen 'byung ldan du bsam zhing bsnyen pa bya/ gtor ba na yang de bzhin bya/ dbang gi lha rab gnas byed na/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi ngo bo khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po g.yas lcags kyu/ g.yon zhags pa/ sku mdog dmar po ru me tog rnams bskyed la/ bsnyen pa bskyar/ dgug gzhug byed gsungs/ yang rten rnying pa 'dre can la rab gnas byed na/ bdag bskyed me tog khro bor bskyed/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad khro bor byon nas/ me tog la thim par bsam zhing bsnyen pa byed/ gtor tsa na yang de bzhin du byed gsungs/ me tog gi zhal gdams sangs rgyas ri gong ba'i gsung*/ shangs pa'i zhal gdams yi ger bkod pa'o// bla ma'i sku 'bag la rab gnas byed na/ sngon 'gro gzhan dang khyad par med/ dngos gzhi bla ma yi dam du bskyed la/ ye shes pa bstim/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab/ spyan dbye sogs gzhan dang khyad par med/ longs sku yin na skra shad la sogs pas mnga' dbul la/ sems can gyi snang ba la sprul skur bsam/ bla ma sngags pa yin na des chog dbu skra bsil ba'i spu gri gtad pa sogs sprul sku'i cho ga dgos gsungs/ des gzhan la 'gre/ sku 'bag rab gnas bla ma'i gsung bkod pa'o// rab gnas me tog 'thor ba tsam la/ rang dang me tog sgrol ma ljang ser cig tu bsams la/ na mo bud+dha'i gsol 'debs kyis 'thor gsungs/ sgrol ma las kyi lha yin/ ljang ser rgyas pa'i las 'grub pa yin/ me tog 'thor ba'i dus tshod ni/ ri rtse la nyi ma shar bar bshad kyang lag len nam phyed yol/ lha 'dre mi gsum nyal ba'i dus tshod/ mis ma tshor bar gtor gsungs/ nyi ma shar ba'i dus kyang spyi dang mthun nas gtor ba yin gsungs so// khyad par mgon po 'di'i dbang du byas na/ bdag bskyed kha sar+pā ṇi'i thugs kar mgon po/ de'i thugs kar dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa bskyed/

me tog rnams mgon po dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs su bskyed pa 'dra ba la/ ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ khyad par gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs la bstim/ rtsa sngags sid+dhi ma grangs ci mang byas la/ 'thor dus dam tshig pa'i rten de la me tog mgon po mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs su bsams la/ dam tshig pa la ye shes pa chu la chu dang*/ mar la mar bzhin dbyer med du gyur par mos la/ ngag tu bsnyen pa ye dharmā dang*/ na mo bud+dha'i gsol 'debs brjod cing gtor/ mgon po'i spos sbyor bsreg rol mo bya/ spyi dang mthun par bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad dang*/ me tog gtor ba byung na'ang legs so// mgon po yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub skor/ las tshogs/ rjes gnang*/ bris sku rab gnas sogs yig chung la gdams pa rnams kyang dkyus su bris pa zab khyad la gnod kyang*/ rang gzhan lag len bde zhing*/ phan bde che ba la bsams nas/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa nam mkha' stobs rgyas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ dben pa'i gnas mchog 'om bug gi yang dgon du sbyar ba'o// 'di bzhengs dge ba'i phan yon gyis// mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa// tshe ring longs spyod mnga' brnyes shing*// phyi ma sangs rgyas myur thob shog/ ༈ /mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ma hā kā la ḍā ki nī ye/ lha tshogs bla ma'i thugs kyi bcud bsdus pa// grub chen khyung po'i snyan brgyud gser chos mchog /myur mdzad yid bzhin nor bu sgrub pa'i thabs// dngos grub rgya mtsho 'di ni bdag gis bri// de la rten gyi gang zag rdo rje theg pa'i lam la mos shing*/ khyad par mgon po 'di nyid la dad pa dang ldan pas/ thog mar rgyud smin par bya ba'i phyir/ bde mchog la sogs pa'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/

khyad par bla ma mgon po dbyer med dang*/ gtor dbang bar chad kun sel thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa zhus shing*/ de rjes gsol ba lo zla'i bar du gdab/ tshogs 'khor rgya chen po bsham/ bla ma mnyes par byas nas/ 'di rang gi rjes gnang yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ gnas gtsang zhing yid du 'ong bar rdzas rnams tshang bar bsham/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom/ khyad par sems can thams cad dbul ba'i sdug bsngal dang bral nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin nor bu bsgom snyam pa byas la/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i snying ga'i dkyil du thig le dmar zhing dwangs la 'dril ba rgya sran tsam zhig bsam/ de'i nang gi dbus su hūm̐ dkar po dngul chu ltar dwangs pa zhig bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi dbul zhing phongs pa'i sdug bsngal bsal/ yid bzhin nor bu'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus de gnyis dbyer med du khrug gis 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ chos 'byung gru gsum shel ltar dwangs shing phyi nas me ri 'bar ba/ de'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin nor bu sku mdog dung ltar dkar zhing smug rtsi gsar pa byugs 'dra'i dmar mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag drug spyan gsum pa yid tsam khro zhing bzhad pa'i zhal mche ba cung zad 'bur ba/ li khri'i lhun po lta bu'i dbu skra gyen du 'khyil ba/ dpral bar sin+dhu ra'i thig les byugs pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag drug g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug sngon po nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ gnyis pas nor bu dbang gi rgyal po thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gsum pas seng ldeng gi cang te'u khro lo lo 'khrol ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod chen gyi nang du rin po che sna tshogs kyis bkang ba'i bum pa brla g.yon pa la brten te 'dzin cing*/

gnyis pa na rtse gsum/ gsum pa na rdo rje rin po che'i lcags kyu 'bar ba bsnams pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ sor gdub/ 'og pags te nor bu'i rgyan brgyad kyis mdzes pa/ sku stod la glang po che'i ko bas g.yogs shing*/ sku smad la stag lpags gsar pa'i sham thabs dkris pa/ rin po che'i chun 'phyang sna tshogs kyi sne mo la gser dngul gyi dril bu g.yer kha 'khrol ba/ lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang dar sna tshogs kyi 'phyang 'phrul can/ zhabs gnyis dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal chen nas da lta rang 'byon zhing*/ 'gro 'phro bzhugs pa 'dra ba'i zhabs 'og na dpal tshogs kyi bdag po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas sa'i snying po lo ma dang bcas pa zhal du gsol zhing*/ g.yon gyis rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa'i ne'u le bsnams nas sgrub pa po la stsol ba'i tshul mdzad pa/ kha dang bshang lam ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas nor bu lhug lhug 'byung ba re re mnan cing ye shes kyi 'od zer 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa la 'khor dbang sdud kyi ḍā ki dpag tu med pa dang*/ nor bdag gnod sbyin pho mo dpag tu med pas bskor ba'o// mgon po'i spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dmar po dgos 'dod 'byung ba 'dzum pa'i mdangs can/ g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten cing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gi bzhugs pa'o// mgon po'i thugs kar dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ phyag g.yas lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon gyis thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ zhabs gar stabs kyis 'gyings zhing spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig hrig gzigs pa/ khams gsum dbang du sdud cing stong gsum g.yo bar byed pa cig bzhugs par bsam/ de'i thugs kar chos nyid kyi thig le dmar po/

de las 'od zer 'phros pas dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal/ shing tsan+dan rkang gcig gi drung nas myur mdzad yid bzhin gyi nor bu la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin nor lha gter bdag gi tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkha' na tshur ḍa ma ru dang dril bu sgrogs shing dgyes pa'i gar stabs dang bcas pas byon par bsam/ hūm̐/ tsan+dan ljon shing 'khrigs pa'i dur khrod nas// dri bzhon gyis bskyod sprin dkar phung po bzhin// phyag na pad+mo rnam rol bstan srung mchog /mgon dkar 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs gnas 'dir gshegs// lha chen bla ma yid bzhin nor bu yi// bka' sgrub phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dbang du sdud// rnal 'byor mchog la dngos grub stsol ba yi// nor bdag ḍā ki'i tshogs bcas gnas 'dir gshegs// mgon po 'khor bcas thugs rje'i zlos gar gyi// rnam par g.yos pas srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ni// gegs med myur stsol dbul ba'i sdug bsngal kun// ma lus bsal nas 'byor pa rgyas par mdzod// gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dzaḥ zhes dang dzaḥnyer gcig brjod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ chos 'byung dkar dwangs me ri 'bar ba'i dbus// pad dkar gdan dang 'od stong dkyil 'khor steng*// gangs ri ltar dkar zhi chags phyag drug pa/ khyod la rnam dkar dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// rtsa sngags mjug tu/ sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ paṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da/ rū pa/ shab+da/ gan+dhe/ rā sa/ spar+she pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ phyi mchod dang*/ mtheb srin gyis nang mchod gtor la brgyud pa'i bla ma'i mtshan dang*/ rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu 'bru gsum btags la nang mchod dbul/ bzlas pa byed par 'dod na/ snying ga'i chos nyid kyi thig le dmar po'i mthar rtsa sngags bye ru'i phreng ba lta bu dmar hram me ba mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du 'khod de/

de las 'od zer dmar po rno ba lcags kyu'i rnam pa dpag med 'phros/ srid zhi'i dge legs thams cad rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus nas thig le la thim par bsam/ yang 'od zer dmar po tsha zhing rno ba 'phros/ 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro dang nor bdag gnod sbyin rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas de dag gi rgyud rang dbang med par bskul nas srid gsum gyi dngos grub hril gyis bsdus nas rang nyid kyi mdun du zas nor longs spyod ri rab tsam spungs par bsam/ khyad par du rgyal po/ phyug po/ drag rgu/ che rgu/ skyes pa/ bud med la sogs te mi thams cad kyi snying nang du 'od zer 'phros/ mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin rnams kyi rig pa dang bcas pa zhugs/ mi thams cad kyi shes pa rang dbang med par bsgyur te bdag gi dbang du 'ubs kyis 'dus par bsam/ de yang khyad par du rang gang dbang du sdud par 'dod pa de'i snying gi dkyil du mi de'i rnam shes nṛ ljang gu nya mig tsam zhig yod par bsam/ de mkha' 'gro dang gnod sbyin rnams kyi snying ga'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus tsir gyis bzung nas bdag gi dbang du byas par bsam mo// mkha' 'gro dang gnod sbyin la brten pa'i zab khyad do// tshogs bdag la brten pa'i zab khyad yod de de nyid kyi sgos grub las shes par bya'o// de lta'i mkhas rlom rig rgyal 'ga' zhig gis// zab khyad 'di dag rna bar ma tshor bar// longs spyod 'dod nas u tshugs mun mda' 'phen// de dag nam mkhar mdzub ris bri 'dod mtshungs// des na kho bo skal ba bzang snyam mo// de ltar gong bzhin dmigs pa gsal pos/ gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dzaḥ zhes pa'i yig 'bru bcu gsum/ gi gu bzhi/ zhabs kyu gnyis te khams gsum dbang sdud kyi snying po 'di tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par 'bum phrag gsum chu bo'i gzhung bzhin du bzla'o// de nas rtags rab mngon sum/

'bring nyams snang*/ tha ma rmi lam du mgon po dang*/ mkha' 'gro dngos su mthong ba dang*/ bla ma dur khrod nas 'byon pa dang*/ rig ma mtshan ldan dngos grub ster ba dang*/ khams gsum sems can la dbang bskur ba dang*/ nyi zla shar ba dang*/ gos dkar po gyon pa dang*/ bum pa thod pa nor bu rnyed pa la sogs pa'i rtags 'byung ngo*// de ltar rtags byung na 'grub pa yin pas/ tshe ring nad med khams gsum dbang du 'dus/ lha srin bran du khol/ rmi lam zin/ bar do med par 'tshang rgya'o// thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na 'bras sam/ nas dkar rjen btags kyi phye mar zho dang sbrus pa'am/ zan chu rkyang pa las kyang rung la/ dbyibs dpal bshos zur gsum pa khru gang ba mtha' mar zan ril mo sum brtsegs kyis skor ba mar dang bu ram sbrang rtsi'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i rtse mor mar gyi nor bu dbang rgyal gzug tha mar mtheb kyu brgya rtsa brgyad bcad kham nang du bstan nas bskor/ mgon po'i tsakli dang*/ mda' bya rgod ma mes ma bzhur ba la dar dkar dmar mthing gsum btags pa gzug gzhan yang sha lnga dang*/ zas sna tshogs kyis snod khengs par bkang la g.yas su mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma/ g.yon du gzhi bdag gi gtor ma/ rgyab tu gnod sbyin gyi gtor ma/ mdun du nyer spyod dang nang mchod la sogs pa'i gtor ma bsham/ byin gyis brlabs pa ni mgon po bzhin bya'am/ bsdu na oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyi ljags rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad gsol bar bsams la/ rtsa sngags mjug tu/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes lan lnga brjod/ dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sangs rgyas bstan srungs rnal 'byor gyi// tshe srings longs spyod rgyas par mdzod// khams gsum 'gro ba dbang du sdus// zhes brjod/ gzhan yang 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/

bstod pa bya/ de nas snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu mgon po la thim/ de 'od du zhu mkha' 'gro ma la thim/ de 'od du zhu sngags phreng la thim/ de 'od du zhu thig le la thim par bsam zhing*/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas ngag gi rlung rgyu ba rang sor bzhag sems kyi dus gsum gyi spros pa bcad/ dang po rang gi sems chos nyid kyi thig le dmar po gsal zhing 'tsher bar gyur pa de la sems gtad de ji snyed cig bsgom/ bar du thig le de yang 'od du yal song ba'i ngang nas/ spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba de'i ngang la ji tsam gnas kyi bar 'jog mthar/ de ltar bzhag pa'i ngang nas rig pa de rig stong*/ 'gyu ba de 'gyu stong*/ gsal ba de gsal stong yin min gyi mtha' dang bral ba'i rmi lam gyi snang ba sgyu ma'i rang bzhin zhes pa de la gab ste ngo sprod pa'o// zhes pa khyung po rnal 'byor gyi bzhed pa'o// bla ma gong ma dag 'di nyid yid bzhin nor bu'i rdzogs rim du bzhed do// slar yang yid bzhin nor bu'i skur gsal stong sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang lha skur langs la nyal 'chag 'gro 'dug gi snang ba thams cad de'i ngang nas bya'o// myur mdzad yid bzhin nor bu bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i thabs dngos grub kun gyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bla ma rā hu la gup+ta badz+ra dang*/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor gyi bzhed srol la/ bla ma'i gsung las byung ba'i zhal shes kyis rnam par brgyan nas/ rnam dkar yon tan rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'i 'brong rtse nas nang so'i bka' dang du blangs shing*/ gzhan yang rang rang gi slob ma 'ga' zhig gis bskul ngor/ dpal ldan mgon po'i rnal 'byor pa dge tshul rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gsal rgya mtshos sbyar ba 'di rdzogs so/ ༈ /dpal ldan bla ma'i mkhyen rab las bskrun lha mchog sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi// nor bu'i 'byung gnas rgya mtsho che 'di 'bad pas sug bris nyid byas tshe// thog ma bar du dge ba'i ltas bzang dngos grub nor bu'i dga' ston ni// ma lus kun gyi 'byung gnas rgya mtsho chen po nyid du gyur pa lags// sā dhu pā sh+ya ho//

༈ /mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi yi ge rnams bzhugs/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i zhabs btud nas// myur mdzad yid bzhin nor bu'i gzi ldan mchog /sgrub thabs bla ma'i man ngag gsung mang na'ang*// dad ldan don gnyer ldan phyir gsal bar bri// de'ang sgrub pa po lam thun mong bas rgyud legs par sbyangs te/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs te/ tshe 'dir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas don du gnyer bas/ theg pa bla na med pa bde mchog la sogs pas dbang legs par thob cing*/ de'i dus khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrung zhing*/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi bka' dang*/ yid bzhin nor bu rang gi sgos kyi rjes gnang legs par thob pas/ dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan par/ sgrub pa'i rdzas rnams tshogs par byas nas/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes sogs nas/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus dang*/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis bsnyen sgrub bgyis pa'i bsod nam kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum la sogs pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyud dang 'gre bar bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs nas/ tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ de nas/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i snying gi dkyil du thig le dmar po rgya sran tsam gcig gi dkyil du/ hūm̐ dkar po dngul chu'i mdog 'dra ba gcig gnas par gyur/ de gnyis las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sems can gyi dbul ba'i sdug bsngal bsal/ tshur 'dus de gnyis rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bor dbyer med du khrug gis 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/

mdun du bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin nor bu sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa'i dpral bar mkha' 'gro'i thig les mdzes pa/ zhal khro 'dzum gyi nyams dang ldan zhing*/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ gnyis pas rin po che dbang gi rgyal po thugs kar 'dzin pa/ tha mas seng ldeng gi ḍa ma ru drag tu 'khrol ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa'i nang na gnas pa'i rin po che sna tshogs kyi bum pa brla g.yon pa la brten nas 'dzin pa/ bar pas rtse gsum/ tha mas rdo rje rin po che'i lcags kyu bsnams pa/ sku stod la rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang*/ glang po che'i ko bas brgyan cing*/ smad stag gi pags pas sham thabs dang*/ rin po che'i chun 'phyang sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa/ zhabs dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas da lta rang byon pa 'dra ba/ 'od 'phro la bzhugs pa 'dra ba'i zhabs 'og na tshogs bdag glang sna dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ g.yas sa'i snying po lo ma dang bcas zhal du gsol zhing*/ g.yon rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa'i ne'u le bsnams nas sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol bar mdzad pa/ kha bshang lam ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas rin po che'i lhug par 'byung ba de nyid mnan cing*/ phyag zhabs thams cad la gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha 'khrol ba/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gnod sbyin dpag tu med pas bskor ba'i skur gyur/ mgon po'i spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog dmar po/ rdo rje 'chang dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ g.yas pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/

mgon po'i thugs kar dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas lcags kyu/ g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa/ zhabs gar stabs kyis 'gying zhing*/ spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig ge gzigs pa/ khams gsum dbang du sdud nus pa gcig bsam/ de'i thugs kar chos nyid kyi thig le dmar po 'od zer 'phro ba gcig gnas par gyur/ de las 'od 'phros/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas/ mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu la sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ hūm̐/ bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas// dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs ma hā kā lā ya// dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang*// dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod// 'di'i rtsa sngags kyi rjes su dzaḥnyer gcig brjod gsungs/ de nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par gyur/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad// dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'i lha// bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor bu la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// de nas mchod pa ni/ nag po'i skong ba ltar byin gyis brlabs nas dbul/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di// myur mdzad 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// dngos grub stsol phyir bzhes su gsol// gu ru ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad gzhan rnams sngar dang 'dra ba las/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ sil snyan/ gzugs mchog sgra/ dri/ ro/ reg bya zhes pa rnams spel zhing*/ sngags kyi thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da/ rū pa/ shab+da/ gan+dhe/ rā sa/ spar+she zhes pa rnams kyis spel te/

phyag rgya dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod pa ni phyi mchod do// nang mchod ni/ yi dam gang byed dam/ nag po'i ltar byin rlabs byas te mtheb srin gyis blangs te spyi bor gtor nas/ 'di'i sgos kyi bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang*/ snying ga nas gtor/ yi dam rnams dang*/ lte ba nas gtor/ rtsa sngags dang*/ nag po'i srog sngags la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum btags la dbul/ gzhan yang 'khor rnams dang*/ chos skyong rnams dang*/ gzhi bdag rigs drug sogs la 'bul ba spyi 'gro ltar bya'o// de nas gong gi bstod pa bsdus pa de'am/ yang na zur na yod pa'i bstod pa rgyas pas bstod par bya'o// de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ thig le la rtsa sngags kyis bskor bar bsgoms nas byed/ 'di'i man ngag shin tu gal che ba yin/ de yang thig le'i mtha' mar yi ge bcu gsum gyis bskor ba las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad bsdus pa'i bcud bde dge yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rang dbang med par bkug thig le la thim pas rnal 'byor pa la tshe dang bsod nams dang*/ dpal dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ bde legs char bzhin du babs par gyur/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi lha klu gnod sbyin stobs ldan rnams dang*/ mi'i dbang po la sogs pa'i stobs ldan thams cad bkug ste/ tshogs bdag la bstims pas/ de dag thams cad rnal 'byor pa'i bka' bzhin du nyan cing*/ bran bzhin du las bsgrubs par gyur par bsams nas/ ngag tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par/ bsnyen sngags 'bum phrag gsum chu bo'i gzhung bzhin bzla/ zhes khyung po'i gsung sgros las byung ba las/ bdag gi bla ma mkhas grub chos rjes ni/ ya ra can bzlas na rgyud sde dang mthun pas legs zhes gsungs/ bzla bya'i sngags ni/ gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dzaḥ zhes pa yin la/ bzlas pa grub pa'i rtags dang*/ grub nas las la sbyor ba'i spel tshig gi sbyor tshul sogs ni man ngag las shes par bya'o// bzlas pa rdzogs nas sngar ltar mchod bstod byas la/

thun tha ma yin na de'i gtor ma 'bul dgos pas/ de'i tshul ni/ nas dkar mo rjen 'thags byas pa'i rtsam pa la nang mchod/ sha mar/ sbrang rtsi sogs sbyar ba'i dpal bshos zur gsum/ mtheb kyu grangs tshad bskor zhing rtse mo mar gyi nor bus brgyan pa'am/ mar rkyang pa'i gtor ma'am/ zan kyu bcangs te/ nang mchod kyis sbyang*/ las sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ rgyas par ni nag po'i byin rlabs ltar/ bsdus pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum mam bdun brjod pas/ zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho lta bur gyur ces byin gyis brlabs te/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis drangs nas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rtsa sngags la/ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa gsum gyis bsngos nas/ mchod bstod sngar ltar bya/ thun mtshams dang gtor ma'i rjes su gsol ba gdab cing*/ thal mo sbyar bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin nor bu gzi ldan thugs rje can khyod la gsol ba 'debs so// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung shig dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod cig dge 'dun gyi chos 'khor skyongs shig bla ma'i sku tshe srings shig khyad par du rnal 'byor pa bdag la snyan pa'i grags pas sa steng ma lus pa khyab pa dang*/ dgos 'dod char bzhin du babs nas longs spyod zad mi shes pa dang*/ mi nor zas gsum 'du zhing thos bsam sgom gsum gyi phrin las thams cad 'bad med du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bdun la sogs pa gsol ba gdab par bya'o// de nas nye bar bsdu na/ snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang mgon por gsal ba la thim/ de 'od du zhu nas mkha' 'gro ma la thim/ de 'od du zhu nas sngags phreng la thim/ de 'od du zhu nas thig le la thim par bsam zhing*/ thig le la sems rtse gcig tu 'dzin no// de'ang 'od du yal song ba'i ngang nas spros pa'i mtha' thams cad bral ba yin no snyam du bzhag par bya'o// 'di la bla ma rnams rdzogs rim gyi tha snyad mdzad par gda'/

slar yang skad cig gis ldang ba'i ngang las/ skad cig gis dpal yid bzhin nor bu'i skur gyur/ ces gsal la stong pa sgyu ma'i skur ldang bar bya ste/ nyal 'chag 'gro 'dug gi snang ba thams cad 'di'i ngang nas nyams su blang bar bya'o// bdag mdun gcig tu byas nas bsnyen pa'i tshul gyis yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub pa'i thabs gsal bar bstan zin to// gu h+ya sa ma ya/ 'di'i rjes gnang la/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum la/ dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal gru gsum 'bar ba'i me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su hūm̐ bris pa'am/ tshom bu gang rung du dgod/ mañdzi'i steng du gtor ma rgyan dang bcas pa bzhag mchod pa dang gtor mas bskor/ slob ma 'jug pa ni/ 'chi ba mi rtag 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ mgon po ji ltar thugs bskyed pa gzhung las 'byung ba ltar byas nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung*/ snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// chos la= dge 'dun la= bla ma dang yi dam lha dang ye shes mgon po spyan ras gzigs la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum/ sems bskyed/ yan lag bdun pa gang rung bya/ gnyis pa sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dbab pa/ gzhung gi oṃ dang 'brel bar sku las sku dpag tu med pa chad/ slob ma'i lus la bstim/ mgon por bskyed/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la 'go bar mdzod// ces gsol/ mgon po'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags phreng byung*/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la 'go bar mdzod// sngags kyi byin rlabs zhugs par mos shing*/ mthar rang dang dkyil 'khor gyi hūm̐ gnyis las 'od 'phros pas/ shar lho mtshams nas ye shes kyi mgon po myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs 'khor dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ dam tshig pa la bstim/ de nas mgon po'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum/ slob ma mgon por gsal ba'i gnas gsum du'ang 'bru gsum/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi oṃ las 'od zer dkar po byung*/ slob ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ la thim/ bum dbang thob/ āḥs ngag gi/ hūm̐ gis yid kyi dbang thob par bsam/ mgon po'i yi ge gsum pa chad nas gnas gsum du bstim/ mthar bla ma mgon po 'od du zhu/ rang la thim pas khams gsum ma lus pa dbang du 'dus par bsam la/ phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag gtor dbang sogs gzhung gzhan las shes par bya'o// gtor ma dang tshogs dbul/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bsdu/ gtor ma gtong*/ bsngo ba bya/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs/ dbang bzhi nyung ngu dang bcas pa 'di grol mchog gis yi ger bkod pa'o// ༈ /mgon dkar gyi rjes gnang gi phyag len nag po 'gro shes bklag chog tu bkod pa bzhugs/ mchog tu 'gyur ba med pa rdo rje'i sku// legs sbyar 'chi med rnga chen phyogs brgyar sgrogs// gang thugs bde chen 'phel ba'i rdo rje 'chang*// skyabs mchog bla mas bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes brjod nas/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i phyag len mthong ba brgyud pa bzhin bri bar bya ste/ de'ang mgon dkar la gtor ma zan dras zlum po'i steng du nor bu mig gsum pa/ de'i steng du dzaṃ bshos kyi dbyibs lta bu la/ rtse rgyan dar dkar gyi gur dang ldan pa/ stegs bu ji ltar 'os pa'i steng du bzhag de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga bsham/ spro na 'bul gtor gnyis kyang bshams te/ slob dpon stan bde ba la 'dug skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon tu btang la/ rang gi snying gi dkyil du thig le dmar po rgya sran tsam pa/ de'i dkyil du hūm̐ dkar po dngul chu dwangs pa'i mdog lta bu cig bsgom/ de gnyis las 'od 'phros/

'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus de gnyis la thim/ snying ga'i hūm̐ dang thig le ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du rang nyid bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin nor bu/ sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig 'dzum zhing khro ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag drug pa/ g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug 'phyar ba/ gnyis pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ gsum pas ḍa ma ru 'khrol ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos thod pa dang bum pa rin po che sna tshogs kyis bkang ba brla g.yon la brten te 'dzin pa/ bar pas rtse gsum/ tha mas lcags kyu bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ sku smad la rin po che'i chun 'phyang sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ zhabs gnyis dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas da lta rang byon pa 'dra ba/ 'byon 'phro la bzhugs pa 'dra ba'i zhabs 'og na tshogs bdag la phug dang ne'u le bzung ba re re mnan te/ kha dang bshang lam sogs nas rin po che lhug lhug 'ong ba/ mgon po'i spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba/

sku mdog dmar po g.yas rin po che g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa bsgom/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ mgon po'i thugs kar dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas lcags kyu/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ zhabs gar stabs ling nge ba/ spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig ger gzigs pa/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa cig tu gyur/ de'i snying gar chos nyid kyi thig le dmar po 'od 'phro ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas mgon po mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim/ gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dzaḥ zhes bsnyen sngags ci nus bzla/ de nas mdun gyi gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mgon dkar du bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim/ gu ru ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra sngon 'gros phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos pad dkar can// 'gro 'di'i phun tshogs re ba skong ba'i slad// rab brjid khro bo'i dbang por sprul pa la// yid bzhin nor bur mtshan gsol khyod phyag 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ 'bul gtor yang 'bru gsum gyis lan gsum byin gyis brlab/ gu ru ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis dbul/ de nas slob ma khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu grub rjes/ slob dpon la maṇ+ḍal dbul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs kyis rgyun bshags lan gsum/ slob dpon gyi sku las 'od zer 'phros/ slob ma'i lus la phog sgrib gnyis sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma rnams bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin nor bu zhes pa nas thig le dmar po 'od 'phro ba zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin bskyed/

de nas dngos gzhi la/ slob dpon dang mdun gyi gtor ma mgon dkar du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal na bzhugs pa'i mgon po'i thugs kar phog bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bka' dang dam tshig rjes su dran pa'i dbang gis/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa skad cig thang cig yud tsam la mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas 'dir byon/ de las de 'dra ba'i sku dpag tu med pa chad/ khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ rol chen bya zhing gu gul gyi dud pas bdug gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dzaḥ ā we sha ya aḥ zhes lan gsum mam lnga brjod/ de ni sku'i rjes su gnang ba yin/ gsung gi rjes gnang zhu ba'i slad du thug 'dun dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad par zhu/ slob dpon la mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud gnang bas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa yi ge ā li kā li dang*/ khyad par ye shes mgon po'i gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad chos skyong spyi'i sngags shā sa na dang*/ mgon dkar 'di nyid kyi sngags gu ru ma hā kā la sogs kyi sngags phreng kha dog dkar po/ rang sgra sgrogs bzhin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang ba 'ur 'ur thib thib byung nas khyod rang mgon dkar du gsal ba'i mgrin pa nas thim/ gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ rol chen dang spos dud bya/ gu ru ma hā kā la sogs kyi sngags sngar bzhin brjod/ de ni gsung gi rjes su gnang ba yin/ thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du mdzad par zhu/ slob dpon la gus 'dud gnang bas/

slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes kyi mgon po'i thugs kyi byin rlabs dang nus pa thams cad rnam pa gri gug dang*/ yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ ḍa ma ru dang*/ thod pa'i phreng ba la sogs pa phyag mtshan bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang ba 'ur 'ur thib thib byung nas mdun gyi nam mkhar gnas pa la sems cher gyis gtad pas/ de rnams 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam par zhu nas/ khyed rang mgon dkar du gsal ba'i snying gar thim pas/ thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ rol chen dang spos dud bya zhing*/ sngags sngar bzhin brjod/ de ni thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba yin/ yang thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du mdzad par zhu/ slob dpon mgon dkar du gsal ba dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi mgon po gnyis kyi spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba/ gsang gnas rnams su dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas lcags kyu/ g.yon thod pa/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs/ spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig ger gzigs pa re lam ste gsal btab pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'i sku las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi zas nor bcud g.yang la sogs pa'i dngos grub 'ub kyis bsdus nas/ khyed rang la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ rol chen dang spos dud bya/ sngags sngar bzhin brjod/ de nas bzlas lung gi slad du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las/ sngags phreng dang po/ gnyis pa/ gsum pa rnams chad pas khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim pas/ thugs rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dzaḥ zhes pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du phyag gis me tog 'thor ba re gnang la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog de sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te/ khyed rang gi dbu'i gtsug tu phul bas sngags kyi dngos grub myur du thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ slob ma'i mgo la me tog 'thor zhing*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// mgon dkar yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i sku gsung thugs gsang sngags rig sngags kyi nus mthu dang byin rlabs thams cad rig pa 'dzin pa 'di'i rgyud la 'jug cing brtan par gyur cig brjod/ de nas gtor ma mgon dkar du gsal ba slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzhag la/ gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dzaḥ sa ma ya sma ra/ sa ma ya ma ti kra ma tha/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ rdo rje 'chang*/ dpal sha wa ri/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa/ grub thob rā hu la gup+ta badz+ra/ grub thob khyung po rnal 'byor/ rmog lcog pa rin chen brtson 'grus/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa/ gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub gtsang ma bshang ston/ mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu/ mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ byang sems sbyin pa bzang po/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po/ mang mkhar ba blo gros rgyal mtshan/ pu hrang dpal ldan dar po/ zhe dgon pa rje bsod nams rtse mo/ lo chen dam pa 'gyur med bde chen/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ rdo rje slob ma rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams la 'go zhing 'ches pa dang*/ bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba bar mdzad du gsol/ 'di rnams la sgrub pa byed pa'i dus su 'tsho ba'i yo byad thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/
