tshe dang bsod nams lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rnams gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ khyed rang gi spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i mgon dkar 'od du ltem gyis zhu/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim pas/ mgon po lus dang grib ma ltar du 'grogs te/ srung skyob mdzad pa yin snyam pa'i mos pa gnang bar zhu/ zhes gtso bos ji ltar dang maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsams te rnams spyi dang 'dra/ 'bul gtor steng du 'bul/ yig brgya lan gsum nongs pa bzod gsol/ dge rtsa sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo'o// zhes pa 'di ni lo chen dam pa 'gyur med bde chen gyis ji ltar mdzad pa'i phyag len rnams yid yul du nges par byas pa'i zin bris kyi tho chung la brten nas/ slar sa pho rta lor 'dzad chos sgo thar gling gi gtsug lag khang du lo chen de nyid kyi zhabs pad nye bar bsten pa/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis legs par bkod pa'o// ༈ /mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs// rab brjid kai la sha yi lhun po la// rab gsal nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba ltar// rab mchog bla ma mgon po dbyer med la// rab dwangs blo yis dbyer med gcig tu mchod// rgyal kun thugs rje'i spyi gzugs pad dkar 'chang*// rgyal bstan bsrung phyir zhi khro'i zlos gar gyis// rgyal ba'i mdzad bzang bgrang yas 'gror stsol ba'i// rgyal mchog sgrub thabs mkhas grub mang pos mdzad// de dag rnams kyi legs bshad gces pa'i nor// rang gi yid mtshor 'jags par bya ba'i thabs// yi ger bkod 'di mkhas grags 'dod ma yin// rang nyid dad dang spro ba'i gdung shugs te// 'di la chos bdag mkha' 'gros gnang ba stsol// zhes mchod par brjod cing*/ bshad par dam bca' ba sngon du btang nas/ 'dir dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi zab chos/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje'i zlos gar/

mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya ba 'chad pa la gnyis te/ rten gyi gang zag dang*/ nyams len dngos so// dang po ni/ de'ang sgrub pa po lam thun mong bas rgyud legs par sbyangs te/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs te/ tshe 'dir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas don du gnyer bas/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam la mos shing*/ bde mchog la sogs pa'i dbang bzhi legs par thob pa/ de'i dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung zhing*/ khyad par bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi bka' yid bzhin nor bu'i sgos kyi rjes gnang legs par thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas so// gnyis pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan par/ phyags dar skyang nul sogs byas la/ bla bre dang*/ yol ba sogs yod na bsham/ bris sku sogs sbyin pa/ bye brag gi rten yod na bsham/ ma 'byor na skyon med/ mchod gtor ci 'byor bshams la stan bde ba la 'khod de/ rdo rje skyil krung sogs bsam gtan gyi spyod lam gyis 'dug nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul rnams dmigs te/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis skyabs 'gro byed par bsam zhing snying khong rus pa'i gting nas/ ngag tu/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la= rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la= myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// nyer gcig sogs ci nus sems dang 'dres nges bya/ thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas skyabs yul rnams rang gzhan la thim pas/ dkon mchog gi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par bsam/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma gzhan 'dra ba las/ bdag gi bsnyen sgrub bgyis pa'i bsod nams 'dis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur thob shog /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal nas/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod par bya/ de'i ched du mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes zhe thag pa nas bsam zhing*/ lan gsum brjod/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang*/ zhes sogs kyi tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i snying gi dkyil du chos nyid kyi thig le dmar zhing dwangs la 'dril ba/ rgya sran tsam zhig bsam/ de'i nang gi dbus su hūm̐ dkar po dngul chu ltar dwangs pa gcig bsam/ de gnyis las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ yid bzhin nor bu'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus thig le hūm̐ dang bcas pa la thim/ de gnyis dbyer med du khrug gis 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin gyi nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i rten dang brten par bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ phyi rol du rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du chos 'byung gru gsum shel dkar ltar dwangs shing*/ phyi nas me ri dmar po 'bar ba/ de'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ gam̐ las tshogs bdag gi steng du/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin gyi nor bu dbang gi rgyal po sku mdog dung ltar dkar zhing*/ smug rtsi gsar pas byugs 'dra'i dmar mdangs chags shing brjid pa/ zhal gcig phyag drug spyan gsum pa/ zhal 'dzum khro'i nyams dang ldan zhing mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/

li khri'i chun po lta bu'i dbu skra dang*/ smin ma dang*/ smra ra dmar ser gyen du brdzes shing 'khyil ba/ dpral bar mkha' 'gro ma'i thig le sin+dhu ra'i thig les byugs pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas kyi dang pos ser sna la sogs skyon drug gcod pa'i gri gug sngon po nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ gnyis pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gsum pas seng ldeng gi ḍa ma ru drag tu 'khrol bas mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod chen gyi nang du/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i bum pa ser po brla g.yon pa la brten te 'dzin pas 'dod rgu stsol ba/ gnyis pas dug gsum 'joms pa'i rtse gsum/ gsum pas khams gsum 'gugs pa'i rin po che'i lcags kyu 'bar ba bsnams pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ sor gdub/ 'og pag ste/ nor bu'i rgyan brgyad kyis mdzes pa/ sku stod la glang po che'i ko bas g.yogs shing*/ sku smad la stag lpags gsar pa'i sham thabs dkris pa/ rin po che'i chun 'phyang sna tshogs kyi sne mo la/ gser dngul gyi dril bu dang g.yer kha 'khrol ba/ lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang dar sna tshogs kyi 'phyang 'phrul can/ zhabs gnyis dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas da lta rang byon zhing*/ 'byon 'phro la tshom ste bzhugs pa 'dra ba'i zhabs 'og na/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ mdog dkar po/ phyag g.yas sa'i snying po la phug lo ma dang bcas pa zhal du gsol zhing*/ g.yon gyis rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa'i ne'u le bsnams nas sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol bar mdzad pa/ kha dang bshang lam ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas/ nor bu lhug lhug 'byung ba re re mnan cing*/ ye shes kyi 'od zer me 'od 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa la/

'khor dbang sdud kyi ḍā ki bye ba 'bum sde dpag tu med pa dang*/ nor bdag gnod sbyin pho mo dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ mgon po'i spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dmar mo dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba/ zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs can/ g.yas yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten cing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mgon po'i thugs kar dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing*/ bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon gyis thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ zhabs gar stabs kyis 'gying zhing*/ spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig ger gzigs pa/ khams gsum dbang du sdud cing stong gsum g.yo bar byed pa cig bzhugs par bsam/ mgon po'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs ka'i stod du hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i mkha' 'gro ma'i thugs kar chos nyid kyi thig le dmar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rgya gar shar lho'i mtshams/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal shing tsan+dan rkang gcig gi drung nas myur mdzad yid bzhin gyi nor bu la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin nor bdag gi tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar ḍa ma ru dang dril bu'i sgra sgrogs shing*/ dgyes pa'i gar stabs dang bcas te oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bca'/ spyan 'dren mchod gtor bzlas pa'i skabs rnams su mgon po'i spos sbyor yod na bsreg bstod pa spyan 'dren sogs la ḍa dril kyang spro na byas pas chog hūm̐/ bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas// dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs ma hā ka la che// dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang*// dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod// hūm̐/

tsan+dan ljon shing 'khrigs pa'i dur khrod nas// dri bzhon gyis bskyod sprin dkar phung po bzhin// phyag na pad+mo'i rnam rol bstan srung mchog /mgon dkar 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs gnas 'dir gshegs// lha chen bla ma yid bzhin nor bu yi// bka' sgrub phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dbang du sdud// rnal 'byor mchog la dngos grub myur stsol ba'i// nor bdag ḍā ki'i tshogs bcas gnas 'dir gshegs// mgon po 'khor bcas thugs rje'i zlos gar gyis// rnam par g.yos pas srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ni// gegs med myur stsol dbul ba'i sdug bsngal kun// ma lus bsal nas dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod// gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dzaḥ nyer gcig dzaḥ'am/ k+ṣiṃ nyer gcig rnams brjod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ thal mo sbyar te/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad// dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'i lha// bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor bu la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// chos 'byung dkar dang me ri dmar ba'i dbus// pad dkar gdan dang 'od stong dkyil 'khor steng*// gangs ri ltar dkar zhal gcig phyag drug pa// khyod la rnam dkar dwang bas phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas phyag bya/ mchod pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i rang bzhin stong nyid/ rnam pa rten cing 'brel ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas/ byed las mgon po 'khor bcas thugs mnyes par byed pa'i mchod sprin/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dang*/ gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin/ dngos su 'byor pa dang*/ yid kyis sprul pa la sogs pa/ mchod pa'i sprin phung nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang ba/

'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bur gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs la/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di// myur mdzad 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// dngos grub stsol phyir bzhes su gsol// gu ru ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad gzhan rnams sngar dang 'dra ba las/ zhabs bsil dang*/ pā d+yaṃ/ me tog dang*/ paṣ+pe/ bdug spos dang*/ dhū pe/ mar me dang*/ ā lo ke/ dri chab dang*/ gan+dhe/ zhal zas dang*/ nai wi d+ya/ sil snyan dang*/ shab+da/ gzugs mchog dang*/ rū pa/ sgra snyan dang*/ shab+da/ dri mchog dang*/ gan+dhe/ ro mchog dang*/ rā sa/ reg bya dang*/ spar+she rnams tshigs bcad dang sngags rnams spel te/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas phyi mchod nang mchod byin rlabs yi dam gang byed dam/ yang na a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ kam̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ bh+rūm̐ ām̐ dz+riṃ kham̐ hūm̐ las byung ba'i zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ phyag rgya dang bcas pa lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ bsdu na 'bru gsum gyis chog gsungs/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs te spyi bor gtor nas/ rgyas par na 'di'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod la dbul/ bsdu na/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ snying ga nas gtor la yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du/

lte ba nas gtor la rtsa sngags sid+dhi dzaḥ'i mjug tu/ mgon po yid bzhin nor bu'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro nor sbyin rnams kyi zhal du= chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi= gzhi bdag rigs drug rnams lhar gsal ba'i zhal du= rang gis kyang myang*/ 'di cung zad bsdus pa yin la/ rgyas par na bla med spyi ltar ro// khyung pos mdzad pa la sogs pa'i bstod pa gang rung gis bstod/ bzlas pa byed par 'dod pas/ 'di'i man ngag shin tu gal che ba yin kyang*/ 'dir ma sbas par gsal por brjod na/ mgon po'i thugs ka'i mkha' 'gro ma'i thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ thig le dmar po'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po dang bcas pa bsgoms la/ 'di ltar brjod cing bsam mo// snying ga'i chos nyid kyi thig le dmar po'i mthar/ gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dzaḥ zhes pa'i sngags phreng bye ru'i phreng ba lta bu dmar hram me mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du 'khor/ de las 'od zer dmar zhing rno ba dpag med 'phros pas srid pa 'khor ba dang*/ zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsdus pa'i brtan g.yo snod bcud kyi dge legs phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus nas thig le la thim pas/ rnal 'byor pa la tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal dang dbang phyug dang bde legs char bzhin du 'babs par gyur/ ces brjod cing dmigs pa gsal gang thebs rig pa grung bton cing hur la blangs te bzlas pa bya/ las dang po pas bzlas dmigs mang po dus gcig la mi lcogs pas/ yang na 'di ltar brjod cing bsam/ slar yang 'od zer dmar po tsha zhing rno ba 'phros/ 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro dang nor bdag gnod sbyin rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas/ de dag gi rgyud dbang med du bskul nas srid gsum gyi dngos grub hril gyis bsdus/ rang nyid kyi mdun du zas nor longs spyod ri rab tsam spungs par gyur/

ces brjod cing bsams la bzlas pa bya/ yang 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal po phyug po/ drag rgu che rgu/ skyes pa bud med la sogs te/ mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyi snying du 'od zer mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin rnams kyi rig pa dang bcas pa zhugs/ mi thams cad kyi shes pa rang dbang med par gyur nas bdag gi dbang du 'ub kyis bsdus par gyur/ ces brjod cing sngags bzla/ de yang khyad par du rang gis gang dbang du bsdu bar 'dod pa de'i snying gi dkyil du mi de'i rnam shes nṛ ljang gu nya mig tsam yod pa de/ mkha' 'gro dang gnod sbyin rnams kyi snying ga'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus tsir gyis bzung nas bdag gi dbang du byas par bsam zhing bzla/ mkha' 'gro dang gnod sbyin la brten pa'i zab khyad do// tshogs bdag la brten pa'i zab khyad ni/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi lha klu gnod sbyin stobs ldan rnams dang*/ mi'i dbang po la sogs pa'i stobs ldan thams cad bkug ste/ tshogs bdag la bstims pas/ de dag thams cad kyis rnal 'byor pa'i bka' bzhin du nyan cing*/ bran bzhin du las bsgrubs par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la bzlas pa bya/ skabs 'gar sems gnas lugs kyi steng du 'jog cing bya/ res lha'i spyan dbus ma nas bzung ste rten dang brten pa la sems gtad cing bzla/ res 'ga' snying ga'i sngags klog pa'i tshul dang*/ res ngag tu mi brjod par yid kyis dang*/ gtso cher gong gi bzla tshul de rnams bya/ gang ltar na'ang sems ma yengs par dgos te/ sems gzhan g.yengs pas byas pa ni// bskal par bzlas kyang mi 'grub bo// zhes gsungs/ bzlas pa'i yul phreng ba'ang spyi 'gro ltar byin rlabs dang ldan par bya/ 'di bsgrub pa'i skabs su rang 'dod kyi 'khris med par bya/ bzla bya'i sngags ni dmigs pa gsal pos/ gu ru ma

bla ma nag po chen po dang mkha' 'gro sde bzhis dngos grub rtsol/ hā kā la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dzaḥ zhes pa'i yi ge 'bru bcu gsum/ gi gu bzhi/ zhabs kyu gnyis te/ khams gsum dbang sdud kyi snying po 'di tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par 'bum phrag gsum chu bo'i gzhung bzhin bzla bar bya'o// zhes khyung pos gsungs la/ mkhas grub chos rje'i gsung rgyun las sa ya ra can 'byung ste gang ltar na'ang 'bum phrag bcu gsum kha skong khri tsho bcu gsum dang bcas pa bzlas na legs shing*/ de rnams ni grangs bsnyen gyi dbang du byas la/ mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa ni rtags shig ma byung gi bar du byed pa'o// rtags ni/ rab mngon sum/ 'bring nyams snang*/ tha ma rmi lam/ mgon po dang mkha' 'gro dngos su mthong ba dang*/ bla ma dur khrod nas byon pa dang*/ rig ma mtshan ldan gyis dngos grub ster ba dang*/ khams gsum sems can la dbang bskur ba dang*/ nyi zla shar ba dang*/ gos dkar po gon pa dang*/ bum pa thogs pa dang*/ nor bu rnyed pa la sogs pa'i rtags 'byung*/ de ltar rtags byung na 'grub pa yin pas/ tshe ring*/ nad med/ khams gsum dbang du 'dus/ lha srin bran du khol/ rmi lam zin/ bar do med par 'tshang rgya'o// thun gsum bzhi drug rnams gang rung yin na'ang*/ bsten pa ni mi tshig dang sngags gzhan ma 'dres shing gdan thog gcig tu 'gro dgos/ thun mtshams su 'thor bsnyen gyi tshul du bzla rung yang des bsnyen pa'i go mi chod/ sngon 'gro zhag kha shas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ thun mtshams sdig bshags yig brgya sogs la 'bad/ dngos gzhi mtshams kyi dkyil rang du slebs nas gdan gyi drod ma yal bar bzlas pa rang la 'bad/ sgrub g.yog ma gtogs pa'i mi gzhan dang mi 'phrad/ lha rje nyams can gyi gang zag 'dra mtshams 'og tu 'jug mtshams kyi ring la yi ge dang dngos spyad gsar pa len dgos byung na rang gi mal dang nye bar mi len/

gzhan du blang*/ yig lan kyang mal sa nas mi byed/ mtshams grol ba'i tshe lhod kyis grol/ mtshams dang dge sbyor thams cad mgo mjug lhod la/ dkyil du bsgrim dgos pas/ dge sbyor nas 'dra ma zer ro// spyir mtshams dang dge sbyor gang byed kyang tshe 'di'i 'khri ba bcad dgos/ thog ma med pa nas 'khor bar 'khyams tshul bsams na tshe 'dir phun sum tshogs pa ji snyed thob kyang byed rgyu mi snang*/ 'di'i bsnyen pa'i skabs sgrub thabs dang sngags kyi dag cha tsam ma gtogs dpe cha mang po mi blta/ las dang po pa bsnyen pa'i skabs su yi ge 'bri 'dod pa/ dbyangs 'then pa/ rtsom byed 'dod rnams byung na'ang mi bya/ nges 'byung mi skye na 'chi ba mi rtag 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs ston pa'i dpe kha gsal de 'dra blta/ 'di'i brgyud pa rin chen sna bdun gyi bla ma'i rnam thar cung zad blta/ gzhan spros pa mang po mi bya/ na tsha lta bu byung yang thun ma chag pa tsam byed/ spyir phyi gu yangs mdog kha ba la khong bsgrim pa cig byed dgos/ bzlas pa bsdu dus spro na phreng ba thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung nas/ bde bar gshegs pa sogs dang*/ bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin nor bu sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ ā li kā li/ yig brgya/ rten 'brel snying po rnams tshar gsum re tsam byung na shin tu legs/ bla ma yi dam gyi mtshan nas smos te thun re la sngags gang song gi grangs phul na phan yon che gsungs/ gu ru ma hā kā la sogs sngags mchod tsam dang*/ mgon po yid bzhin nor bu thugs rje can// sku mdog gangs ri ltar dkar 'od zer 'phro// 'gro ba'i dbul phongs sdug bsngal sel mdzad pa'i// 'dod rgu dngos grub stsol mdzad khyod la bstod// mchod bstod bsdus pa tsam byed na bzlas pa'i gong du'ang 'di bzhin no// 'dod don gsol gdab 'dir byas kyang legs/ de rnams ni bskyed rim kyi bya ba'o// thun mtshams su gtor ma ni/

spyir thun mtshams thams cad du byung na legs mod/ tha na'ang thun tha ma la cis kyang byed dgos/ de'i tshul ni/ 'bras sam nas dkar mo rjen 'thags byas pa'i phye'am/ ma 'byor na rtsam pa gzhan dang*/ nang mchod/ bsad sha ma yin pa'i sha skam/ mar khu/ mngar gsum rnams bsres pa'am/ mar ram/ zan chu rkyang pas kyang rung*/ dbyibs dpal bshos zur gsum khru gang ba/ mthar zan ril sum brtsegs kyis bskor ba mar dang bu ram sbrang rtsi'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ rtse mor mar gyi nor bu dbang rgyal gzug mtha' mar mtheb kyu brgya rtsa brgyad bcad kha nang du bstan pas bskor/ mgon po'i tsakli dang*/ mda' bya rgod ma mes ma bzhur ba la dar dkar dmar thing gsum btags pa gzug gzhan yang sha lnga dang*/ zas sna tshogs kyis snod khengs par dgang*/ g.yas su mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma/ g.yon du gzhi bdag gi gtor ma/ rgyab tu gnod sbyin gyi gtor ma/ mdun du nyer spyod dang nang mchod sogs bsham/ nang mchod dang chu chang gis bran/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ kam̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag du ma las grub pa'i gtor ma zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum mam bdun brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas gtor mgron ni bdag mdun gcig tu byas nas bsnyen pa'i tshul yin pas sgrub thabs rnams su gsal por ma gsungs kyang*/ las dang po pa yid ches pa'i phyir du mdun bskyed ni bris sku la sogs pa'i rten yod dam/ rten gtor ram/ dkyil 'khor lta bu'i dmigs rten yod na de la dmigs rten byas nas bskyed/ med kyang rung ste/ swa bhā wa'i sngags brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/

a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po sogs nas dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur gyi bar/ rang nyid ces pa la sogs pa'i tshigs phrad cung zad dor ba tsam ma gtogs mngon rtogs ltar bya/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i dmigs pa ni/ bdag mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs nas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dzaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa gsum mam lnga'am bdun brjod cing rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i phyag rgya bya/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ ḍa dril yod dam med kyang rung ste/ thal mo sbyar la/ dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sangs rgyas bstan bsrung rnal 'byor gyi// tshe srings longs spyod rgyas par mdzod// khams gsum 'gro ba dbang du sdus// zhes brjod/ gzhan yang thal mo sbyar te mos pa rtse gcig pas/ bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin nor bu gzi ldan thugs rje can khyod la gsol ba 'debs so// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs shig dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod cig dge 'dun gyi chos 'khor skyongs shig bla ma'i sku tshe sring shig khyad par du rnal 'byor pa bdag la snyan pa'i grags pas sa steng ma lus pa khyab pa dang*/ dgos 'dod thams cad char bzhin du babs nas longs spyod zad mi shes pa dang*/ mi nor zas gsum 'du zhing*/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi phrin las thams cad 'bad med du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan bdun la sogs pas gsol ba gdab/ bzlas pa'i mjug la sogs pa'i mchod bstod kyi gsham thams cad du 'dis yang yang gsol ba 'debs pa gnad do// rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na gshegs gsol lam mi dmigs pa gang rung bya/ de nas nye bar bsdu ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu ste srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/

srung ba'i 'khor lo chos 'byung dang bcas pa rang mgon por gsal ba la thim/ rang nyid gdan dang bcas pa snying ga'i mkha' 'gro ma la thim/ de 'od du zhu nas sngags phreng la thim/ thig le la sems rtse gcig tu 'dzin/ de hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu khog pa la thim/ khog pa mgo bo la thim/ mgo bo zla tshes/ zla tshes thig le/ thig le nā da la thim/ nā da yang mi dmigs te 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas/ ngag rlung rgyu ba rang sor bzhag sems dus gsum gyi spros pa bcad de 'od du yal song ba'i ngang nas spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba yin no snyam du bzhag de yang dang por thig le'ang sems ring du 'dzin/ de nas rim gyis spros bral du 'jog mthar de ltar bzhag pa'i ngang nas/ rig pa de rig stong*/ 'gyu ba de 'gyu stong*/ gsal ba de gsal stong*/ yin min gyi mtha' dang bral bas rmi lam gyi snang ba/ sgyu ma'i rang bzhin zhes pa de la gab ste ngo sprad pa'o zhes pa khyung po rnal 'byor gyi bzhed pa'o// bla ma gong ma dag 'di la yid bzhin nor bu'i rdzogs rim zhes pa'i tha snyad kyang mdzad/ slar yang skad cig gis stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid dpal yid bzhin nor bu'i skur gyur/ ces brjod cing lha sku snang stong sgyu ma lta bur gsal gdab/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs kyis bsrung ba bya/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /yid bzhin nor bu 'grub gyur nas// sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam bya/ nyal 'chag 'gro 'dug gi snang ba thams cad 'di'i ngang nas bya/ thun mtshams su brgyud 'debs/ bstod pa/ gsol 'debs sogs dge ba'i las la 'bad/ snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes las 'khyar du mi gzhug mgo mjug bar gsum rnams su tshogs 'khor gang 'grub bya/ de yang rang gi 'byor tshod dang bstun nas bshams la/ gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlab/

tshogs phud bla ma yi dam la dbul/ de nas rang dang grogs dam tshig can gyis rol/ lhag ma 'byung por btang ba tsam gyis rung*/ mgon po'i gtor ma dam nyams khyi glang sogs la mi sbyin/ dngos grub tu len/ skabs 'gar skong gso'i mchod 'bul rgyas par byed na yig rnying du shes/ sgrub pa dang las tshogs kyi rim pa sogs rgyas par man ngag logs su shes par bya'o// skabs gzhan du gtor ma ma chag tsam byed tshe/ yi dam chos skyong gzhan dang mnyam du gtor ma zlum gtor nor bu'i rgyan can sogs gang 'byor la brten te ma chag tsam bya/ sbyin sreg kyang yi ge rnying pa ltar ro// gnad gcig la bla ma'i mos gus dang*/ 'di sgrub pa la gzhan gyis ma tshor ba legs/ nor lha gzhan la 'gab 'dre gnon pa sogs dgos na'ang 'di la de 'dra mi dgos shing*/ 'grub thag kyang nye/ tshe 'di'am/ 'chi kha/ bar do sogs su slebs che ba'i gdams pa yin/ 'di'i rgyab rten du yig rnying rnams la 'dris par bya'o// mang pos rna bar ma tshor zhing*// la las ming tsam thos na yang*// 'di 'dra'i rnam gzhag mi shes par// 'dod gdung u tshugs mun rdo 'phen// e ma 'di 'dra'i legs byas ngo mtshar rmad// rā hu la dang khyung po rnal 'byor gyi// gzhung gi bdud rtsi mkhas grub rim brgyud nas// rang nyid bcud len bya phyir 'di bskrun to// 'dis mtshon dge tshogs gang zhig grub pa des// tshe 'di'i bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa dang*// myur du shi 'phos smon pa'i gnas skyes te// rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa'i phul grub shog /ces pa 'di'ang snyom las pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis so// ༈ /mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sbyin sreg bklag pas don 'grub bzhugs/ na mo gu ru ma hā kā lā ya/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ sbyin sreg bya tshul la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/

dang po ni/ thab gnas nyams dga' bar/ sa'i cho ga rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang rung byas pa'i mthar/ thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par gdab/ srad bu khru gang gi tshad gyis dbus nas tshangs thig la phyogs bzhir mtshan ma byas la/ de'i bar gyi srad bu de g.yon pas mtshan ma'i steng nas bzung*/ g.yas pas lho byang gi zur thig la ri mor byas te shar nub la'ang rigs 'gre'o// de'i steng thig bzhi btab pas thab nang dang*/ de'i phyi rol du shar nub la sor brgyad pa gnyis kyi mtshan ma byas la rtags nang ma nas dbus bar gyi srad bu des zur thig bzhi la mtshan ma byas te/ de steng thig bzhi btab pas kha khyer 'byung*/ yang rtags phyi ma nas dbus bar gyi srad bus sngar bzhin zur thig bzhi la mtshan ma byas/ de steng thig btab pas mu ran 'byung ngo*// thab stegs kyi thig mi dgos/ thab nang gi dbus nas sum gnyis phyir bzhag pa'i sum cha zlum por bskor bas pad lte dang*/ phyi'i sum gnyis la gcus thig btab pas pad 'dab bya/ thab kyi gzhi thams cad kha dog ser po bya/ kha sgyer mu ran gang rung la rin po che'i phreng bas bskor/ kha dog 'dres pa'i skyon spong ba'i phyir/ bcad tshon thams cad dang rin po che'i kha dog li khris bya/ dbus su pad nyi'i steng du 'bras dkar ram/ rdul tshon gyi tshom bu dkar po dgod/ de'ang gtso bo'i zhal 'jig rten pa'i lhor bstan pa'i dbang du bya/ bud shing tsher ma can ma yin pa'i 'bras bu can gyi shing*/ ser zhing dri zhim po'i dbus kyi cha las byung ba'am/ de med na srog chags med pa'i nags kyi lci ba thab kyi kha khyer gyi steng nas dpangs khru gang tsam gru bzhir brtsigs pa'i nang gi 'jig rten pa'i shar lho'i mtshams su ting lo che ba gcig kyang bsham/ me ni dge 'dun gyi bsro khang ngam/ rgyal po'i khyim gyi mes bya'o// thab kyi mtha' bskor thams cad byi dor legs par byas la/

dri bzang pos byug de'i mdun du rang gi stan nang tshang can kha dog ser po'i steng du/ sa 'ja' li sogs khyel stegs bya/ rang gi mdun du bsang chu'i snod dung phor sogs dang*/ ku sha'i 'thor yab/ rdo dril nang mchod rnams bsham/ rdo rje dril bu'i bar du dgang gzar kha sbyar la bzhag so sor bzhag na bar chad kyi chos yin gsungs/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad kyang bsham/ grub na thab dang sgrub pa po'i bar du 'jim pa la byas pa'i me yol dkar zhal gyis byugs pa bshams te/ 'di ti se'i gangs rir bsgoms te/ sgrub pa po la 'jig rten rang rgyud pa'i me lha'i rigs kyis nyer 'tshe sel bar bshad/ dpal 'bar zhig kyang sta gon bya/ rang gi g.yon/ thab kyi g.yas nas chu gnyis sngon 'gro nyer spyod dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis dang bcas pa bsham/ rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon nas bsreg rdzas gzi brjid 'phel byed yam shing*/ 'bras bu can gyi shing sbom phra gung mo tsam ser zhing dri zhim pa/ khru gang ba rtsa rtse mar dang sbrang rtsis byugs pa/ 'byor pa 'phel byed mar khu gtsang ma/ bde dge kun ster zhing shes rab 'phel byed 'o mar phye gsum sbrang rtsi sogs bsres pa/ sdig pa 'joms byed til nag dang*/ bgegs zhi byed yungs kar/ nor 'bru 'phel byed so ba/ longs spyod rgyas byed 'bras/ rlung shugs 'phel byed nas/ nad rnams 'joms byed gro/ stobs rnams 'phel byed sran ma/ tshe rgyas byed dūrba/ rdzas rnams dag byed ku sha rnams go rim bzhin bsham/ rdzas rnams la bdud rtsi lngas gtor la bzhag sgrub pa po rang nyid snga dro'i dus su khrus byas/ 'byor na gos rgyan ser pos brgyan/ bdag gi tshe dang longs spyod bsod nams la sogs pa rab tu rgyas te tshim pa'i bsam pas sngar bshams pa'i stan la kha byang du bltas te/ sa 'ja' li la khyel 'dug gis 'dug pa bzang po'i 'dug stangs zhes pa'i spyod lam gyis 'dug go

/gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bzlas pa'i bar/ mgon dkar gyi bdag bskyed tshul bzhin byas la/ 'di nas brtsams te sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub gyi bar la lag pa gnyis pus mo las mi 'da' ba la bslab bo// de nas dpal 'bar che ba zhig la gong du bshad pa'i me sbar te/ yam shing mar la sbags pa'am/ rtsa skam po gzhan dang bcas/ lag pa gnyis gus pa'i tshul gyis thab la g.yas nas zlum por bskor zhing*/ ngag tu/ gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri sogs lan gsum brjod la/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes brjod de/ thab kyi nang gi ting lo la me gso/ khu tshur gnyis bcangs pa'i mtheb mdzub gnyis brkyangs pa'am/ rtse sbyar ba rin po che'i khu tshur gyi phyag rgyas dgang gzar blugs gzar bzung la/ blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi kha la reg cing*/ blugs gzar gyis bud shing la khyab par blugs te/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes brjod/ thab dang yo byad bsang ba ni/ rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis bsang chu la a mṛ ta'am/ hūm̐ ring po 'ga' zhig brjod pas rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ sngags de gnyis gang rung brjod cing ku sha'i 'thor yab kyis thab dang yo byad thams cad bsang gtor byas te bgegs bsal la/ bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas rnams swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i bsregs rdzas dang*/ mchod rdzas 'di rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha mnyes pa dang*/ so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hās yam shing*/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hās mar/ oṃ dz+riṃ swā hās 'bru/ oṃ swa swā hās rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās rdzas thams cad sbyang*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/

oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ sogs nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ thab swa bhā was stong par sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i rgyas pa'i thab khung ser po rgyar khru gnyis pa/ zabs su khru gang ba/ yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ kha khyer ram mu ran la rin po che'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ bris pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las me lha ra skyes la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon dbyu gu dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ser po las 'od zer ser po 'phro ba/ gsus khyim che ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ ag tshom 'phyang ba drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bo gung mo'i rtsa bar bzhag mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po// thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ag+na ye ma hā te dza/ sarba karma pra sā dha ka ma hā bhū ta de wa ṛ ṣi/ dwi dza sa twa ma gṛ hī twā/ ā hu tiṃ ā hā ra/

asmin san+ni hi to bha wa/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod la thab nang du me tog cig phul te/ thab kyi shar lhor pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis chu gnyis dbul/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcings pa'am/ spos dang bcas pa'i dril bu bzung la/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhū ta dz+wa lā ya/ sarba bhasmi ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas bstim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang*/ rdo rje'i bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas dbang lha spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ de nas/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes pa'i mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i nyer spyod lnga/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar oṃ ā hūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs// 'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ de nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa thams cad sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams te/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge// sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// des bdag la bgegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig

/oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ zhes brjod de/ thab kyi mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtse mo g.yas skor du dgram mo// 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i thugs ka'i me gru gsum gyi dbus su pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po dngul chu'i mdog lta bu/ de las 'od zer 'phros sogs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ye shes pa gzhug pa'i bar gyi mgon po mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa mngon rtogs ltar bskyed/ de'i mtha' skor dang bar snang rnams su rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems chos srung nor lha'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar mngon sum du bzhugs par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ lha thams cad 'dzum zhing tshim pa/ 'od zer ser po 'phro ba dang*/ gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod la sogs pa rgyas pa'i las mdzad/ ces brjod cing bsam/ slar yang hūm̐ zhes brjod cing thab dang yo byad thams cad la bsang chus gtor te/ mi gtsang ba dang nyams pa thams cad dag par bsam/ de nas khu tshur gyis gzar bu gnyis bzung ste/ lha thams cad kyi zhal cung zad gdangs par bsams pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsam/ dgang blugs kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang ram̐ bsams te/ gu ru ma hā sogs lan 'ga' zhig mar la sngags te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes pa lan bdun gyis blugs gzar gyis mar blugs pas dgang gzar bkang la/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī byā ā dī byā ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya ba ha nā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod de/ gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la lha thams cad kyi zhal du dus gcig la phul bar bsams la/ mthar bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i 'khor dang longs spyod dang*/ nor dang 'bru dang rin po che la sogs pa 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad puṣ+ḍiṃ ku ru oṃ/

de lta bu lan gsum la sogs pas byon skyems dbul/ gu ru ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang*/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos pad dkar can sogs kyis bstod/ de nas yam shing nas brtsams te bsreg rdzas rnams sde tshan re re'i thog mar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa la sogs pa rang rang rdzas sngags tshar gsum mam lnga la sogs pa dang*/ 'bul sngags gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dzaḥ zhes pa 'ba' zhig gis dbul/ mjug tu spel tshig gong ltar brjod cing brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa ji tsam 'byor pa dbul/ logs nas sgrub g.yog gcig gis grangs bzung ste/ yam shing la sogs pa rnams rim pa bzhin lag pa g.yon du bzung la/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas blangs shing cung zad bskor te/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul/ de'ang yam shing byang chub kyi shing du mos te/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā/ gsum mam lnga sogs dang*/ gu ru ma hā sogs kyis brgya rtsa brgyad dbul/ mjug tu bdag ming 'di zhes sogs kyi spel tshig gong ltar brjod/ 'og ma rnams la'ang 'di'i rigs 'gre sbyar te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hās mar/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hās zho dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya swā hās til lam yungs dkar/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swā hās 'bras so ba/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hās 'bras/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hās nas/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swā hās gro/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hās sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hās dūrba/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ya swā hās ku sha rnams phul la/ sde tshan re re'i mthar gong ltar gyi spel tshig sbyar ro// de nas skabs 'dir khyad par gyi rdzas zas mchog la grangs bzung ste/ rtsa sngags kyis stong phrag lnga'am/ khri la sogs pa

'di ni cho ga tshar re'i sngags gsog tshul yin pa de ltar zhag grangs du mar bsnyen pa ji tsam song ba'i bcu cha'i kha skong ma 'grig bar du bya'o// ji tsam nus pa 'bul zhing*/ skabs skabs su yam shing dang mar ci 'byor pa dbul/ sgrub g.yog gcig gis me rgyun ma chad tsam gyi bud shing yang 'jug go /de yang yam shing 'bar ba'i me 'od la/ zhu ba'i rdzas rnams ni lha thams cad kyi zhal du/ gong bu'i rdzas rnams ni phyag tu/ ku sha ni dbu'i gtsug tor la phul bar bsam mo// bsreg rdzas rnams rdzogs pa dang*/ gong byon skyems kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang blugs gsum 'bul/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos byin gyis brlabs te/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yi// sogs tshigs bcad sngags phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ nang mchod kyi phud nas bla ma yi dam sogs la dbul/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma la bar phud dbul/ lhag ma chos skyong dang 'byung po rigs drug sogs la'ang mchod la/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ lha thams cad kyi ngo bor mchod par bsams te/ bdud rtsi cung zad lce la myangs la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas phyogs bcu dus gsum sogs sam/ mi shes na gong ltar/ dus gsum rgyal ba sogs kyis bstod/ 'das pa'i gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ gu ru ma hā sogs rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags pa gsum mam lnga sogs phyag rgya dang bcas pas dbul/ mchod pa phyi nang dang bstod pa bya/ bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang longs spyod la sogs pa rnam 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes sogs rang gi yid la gang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la skabs 'dir yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// zhes sogs dang*/ bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas/ sems sgrib pa dang ldan pa'i dbang gis/

ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ bying ba dang*/ rgod pa'i dbang gis cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa thams cad bzod par gsol bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs kyi rjes su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra muḥzhes dang*/ mtheb srin gyi se gol gyi sgras/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ srin lag gis thab kyi rdul cung zad blangs la dpral bar bskus te dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam/ gsum pa rjes la/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha la bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams yam shing nas ku sha'i bar/ bdun nam bcu gcig sogs ci 'byor dbul/ spel tshig kyang 'dra/ mar dgang blugs gsum gyi sbyin sreg dbul/ yon bdag la sogs pa'i don du byed na/ de'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong dgang gzar dang lhan cig tu bzung la/ bdag gam yon bdag sogs spel tshig gong ltar brjod/ bdun tshan gsum po re re'i mthar byas pa'o// gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlab/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes sogs gsum mam lngas dbul/ mtshan sngags re re nas sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang*/ nang mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rigs bya/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i 'khor dang longs spyod dang*/ nor dang*/ 'bru dang*/ rin po che la sogs pa 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol zhes dang yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ oṃ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās bsang gtor dang*/

oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swā hās 'thor 'thung phul la/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyi gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ ag+na ye gats+tsha/ zhes dang*/ dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed de/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po zhes sogs kyis bsrung ba bya/ thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin du// sogs kyi bsngo ba smon lam ci shes/ 'bad dang rtsol ba sogs bkra shis gang shes bya/ mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa yin na/ me ma shi'i bar du mi bsgul shi ba dang gzhan reg tu mi gzhug par rang gis phyags la gnas dben par bskyal/ thun mong gi dngos grub tsam la 'phral du phyags la thab kyi shul dang nye 'khor thams cad dri zhim po'i chus byugs te me tog la sogs pa gtor la bkra shis par bya'o// 'di ni btsun pa snyom las pa bud+dhi lak+ṣ+mīṃs bris pa'o// dge legs dpal 'byor rgyas pas phyogs kun khyab gyur cig/ ༈ /mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu la gnad nas bskul ba'i tshigs bcad bzhugs so// dpal ldan brtse ba'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs// snyigs ma'i gnas tshul gzigs pas thugs 'byung nas// zhag bdun brgyal zhing slar yang dgongs pa'i phul// snyigs ma'i sems can tshe thung bar chad mang*// rkyen dbang 'gro zhing longs spyod 'tsho ba dman// sgrub long med par bar chad dbang du 'gro// dam tshig mi bsrung dme 'khrug chos min byed// chos byed rloms kyang bar do mi chod pa// de dag gzigs nas yun la mi ltos par// dran cing gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis kyang*// bsam kun yid bzhin nor ltar 'grub ces pa'i// bden pa gnad nas bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs// dbul phongs sdig sdug gis gzir mgon med rnams// yid la re ba mtha' dag rdzogs bgyid pa'i// sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin 'bras bsod nams tshogs// myur du rdzogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes pa 'di yang bha dan+ta bud+dha lak+ṣ+mīṃs dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du bgyis pa'o//

༈ /mgon dkar gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// na mo gu ru we/ gsang ba rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang*// byams dang snying rje'i mnga' bdag sha wa ri// mkhas shing grub pa'i mnga' bdag mi tri pa// gsang ba'i mnga' bdag gsum la gsol ba 'debs// mthu stobs dbang phyug grub chen rā hu la// grub pa'i dbang phyug khyung po rnal 'byor zhabs// mkhas pa'i dbang phyug rin chen brtson 'grus te// mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug gsum la= spyan ras gzigs grub dbon ston skyer sgang ba// grub brnyes gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor zhabs// 'gro mgon chen po sangs rgyas ston pa ste// 'gro ba'i 'dren pa gsum la= mkhas grub chen po gtsang ma shangs ston dang*// mus pa chen po rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po// bla ma chen po rdo rje gzhon nu ste// chos rje bla ma gsum la= 'khrul zhig mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa// byang sems chen po sbyin pa bzang po'i zhabs// grub thob chen po thang stong rgyal po ste// grub pa'i mchog gyur gsum la= blo gros rgyal mtshan mtshan can mang mkhar ba// dpal ldan dar po'i mtshan can pu rong ba// zhe dgon chos rje bsod nams rtse mo ste// skye rgu'i 'dren pa gsum la= lo chen dam pa 'gyur med bde chen dang*// rje btsun ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs// bdag po ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan te// mkhyen brtse gter chen gsum la= bkra shis snyan par grags pa'i dpal ldan dang*// mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan sangs rgyas dpal bzang pa// mgon dang dbyer med rtsa ba'i bla ma ste// bka' drin che ldan gsum la gsol ba 'debs// dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs dang bcom ldan 'das// yid bzhin nor bu mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas dang*// gzhan yang phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la// zol med snying nas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa kun gyis mchod// sdig pa kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang*// chos 'khor bskor zhing rtag par bzhugs su gsol// dge rnams bla med byang chub thob phyir bsngo// khyed la gus pas 'dod don zhu ba ni// gnas skabs su yang chos dang mthun pa'i don// tshe ring nad med lang tsho'i dpal thob nas// mthun rkyen gong 'phel nyid du mdzad du gsol// khyad par mdzad med longs spyod dpal thob nas// de nyid log pa'i 'tsho bar mi 'gyur bar// yar mchod sbyin gtong la sogs bsod nams kyi// tshogs chen myur du rdzogs par mdzad du gsol// thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i sa lam gyi// theg chen lam gyi rim pa legs bgrod de// kun mkhyen sangs rgyas go 'phang mthon po nas// sdug bsngal ldan pa'i 'gro la gzigs par shog

/ces tshig don yid la bsam zhing*/ ma yengs par gsol ba drag tu gdab bo// zhes mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di ni don gnyer gyi bzhed pa bzhin bik+ṣu bud+dha lak+ṣ+mīṃs bris pa 'dis rang gzhan gyi chos dang mthun pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig/ ༈ /mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor man gyi brgyud pa de gsol 'debs 'di skul ba po'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ltar bris pa yin la/ bdag gis thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa'i rjes su/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang*// ni gu'i chos la dbang bsgyur sangs rgyas bzang*// mkhas grub mtshungs med gsum la= /nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhes grags mtsho sgo ba// rnal 'byor dbang phyug kun dga' bsod nams zhabs// sngags 'chang chen po dkon mchog legs 'dzin rje// 'gro ba'i skyabs mchog gsum la= /e waṃ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub rje// gang de'i sku dbon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan zhabs// 'jam dbyangs bla ma nam mkha' dpal bzang po// rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab gsum la= /kha skong ni/ mkhyen brtse'i gter chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang*// rnam 'dren mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub zhabs// bstan 'gro'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan chos skyong ste// phan bde'i mchog stsol gsum la= /mkhas btsun dam pa rin chen mchog grub dang*// thams cad mkhyen dbang nam mkha' 'chi med zhabs// rdo rje 'chang dngos 'jam dpal bzang po ste// bka' drin nyams med gsum la gsol ba 'debs// zhes so// 'khor 'das rang sems rmi lam sgyu ma la// gsal stong lhan skyes 'od gsal bde ba che// stsol mdzad dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /skyabs gnas kun 'dus zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs dang bcom ldan 'das// zhes pa man chad sngar ltar sbyar ro// ༈ /mgon po yid bzhin nor bu'i skor las/

na mo bud+dha'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs che ba bzhugs// bla ma mgon po dbyer med du bsams la/ na mo bud+dha ya/ phyag 'tshal lo sangs rgyas la/ na mo gu ru he/ phyag 'tshal lo bla ma kye/ badz+ra bī ra bī ra ni/ rdo rje dpa' bo dpa' mo/ shrī ḍā ka ḍā ki nī/ dpal mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma/ dzo ka dzo ki nī/ rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma/ sarba bud+dha bo dhi sa twā ya sha ra ṇaṃ gats+tshā mi kye kye/ thams cad sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' la skyabs su mchi'o// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis= dpa' bo dang dpa' mor bcas pa thams cad kyis= sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis= dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig ye shes la sgrib pa mi mnga' ba/ mthu dang nus pa la thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga' ba/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis sku'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig gsung gi sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig ces brjod do// de ltar rje btsun phyag na pad+mo'i thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub skor 'di ni/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab thor bur bzhugs pa gces spras su bya ba'i phyir dang*/ deng sang phal cher sgrub thabs rjes gnang tsam re las/ yig cha rnams thos bsam gyi yul du byas pa dkon par snang ba'i phyir/

rang gzhan kun la phan thogs par gyur na ci ma rung snyam pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te/ dge slong snyom las pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi dgon par bsgrigs pa'i yi ge pa ni mdo khams lho smad pa/ shes rab lhun grub kyis gus pas bgyis pa 'dis bstan pa dang sems can thams cad la phan thogs par gyur cig/ ༈ /mgon po dkar po yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i yi ge khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// stobs bcu'i dbang phyug dpal stug sras dang bcas// ji snyed ma tshang med par yongs 'dus zhal// dran pas srid zhi'i dpal 'jo bla ma dang*// zung min mgon po yid bzhin nor bus skyongs// gang gi thugs rje'i 'dab stong dgod pa las// thun mong mchog dngos 'dzad med re bde'i dpal// nyer 'dren sgrub thabs rjes gnang bung ba'i glu// skal bzang legs bris gzhon nu'i sgra 'dzin dpyid// 'phags yul grub dbang mkhyen rab mtha' med kyi// ral pa las brgyud mkhas grub khyung po yi// dka' spyad bha gi ra thas nyer phab klung*/ dngos grub rin chen rdul phreng 'dren pa brtsam/ de'ang thog mar 'di'i rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro spyi ltar ci nus dang*/ sems can thams cad dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rang gi snying gi dkyil du thig le dmar po rgya sran tsam/ de'i dkyil du hūm̐ dkar po dngul chu dwangs ma'i mdog lta bu cig bsgom/ de gnyis las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/

sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus de gnyis la thim/ snying ga'i hūm̐ dang thig le ro gcig tu 'dres pa las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das mgon po yid bzhin nor bu sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig 'dzum zhing khro ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag drug pa/ g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug 'phyar ba/ gnyis pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ gsum pas ḍa ma ru 'khrol ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos thod pa'i nang bum pa rin po che sna tshogs kyis gang ba brla g.yon la brten te 'dzin pa/ bar pas rtse gsum/ tha mas lcags kyu bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ sku smad la dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs dang rin po che'i chun 'phyang sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ zhabs gnyis dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas da lta rang byon pa 'dra ba/ 'byon 'phro la bzhugs pa 'dra ba'i zhabs 'og na tshogs bdag la phug dang ne'u le bzung ba re re mnan pa'i kha dang bshang lam thams cad nas rin po che lhug lhug 'ong ba/ mgon po'i spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ g.yas rin po che g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mgon po'i thugs kar dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs ling nge ba/ spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig hrig gzigs pa/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa cig tu gyur/ de'i snying gar chos nyid kyi thig le dmar po 'od 'phro ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas mgon po mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ gu ru ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar dang*/ oṃ rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du shab+da/ gan+dhe/ rā sa/ spar+she rnams kyis mchod/ nang mchod 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs te/ mtheb srin gyis 'thor ba'i tshul dang*/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang rang gis myang*/ 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro nor sbyin rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod la/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ snying ga'i chos nyid kyi thig le dmar po'i mthar rtsa sngags bye ru'i phreng ba lta bus bskor ba las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i dbyibs can grangs med pa 'phros pas/ srid zhi'i dge legs dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus nas thig le la thim par bsams la/ gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dzaḥ zhes pa ci nus bzla/ yang 'od zer sngar bzhin 'phros/ 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas rgyud bskul/ srid pa gsum gyi dngos grub thams cad ril gyis bsdus nas rang gi mdun du zas nor longs spyod ri rab tsam spungs par bsam/ khyad par stobs 'byor che rgu thams cad kyi snying du 'od zer mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin rnams kyi rig pa dang bcas pa zhugs/ de dag gi rgyud rang dbang med par bskul nas bdag gi dbang du 'dus par bsam/ khyad par dmigs yul gyi snying dkyil rnam shes nṛ ljang gu nya mig tsam yod pa/ mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin rnams kyi snying ga'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus tsir gyis bzung nas bdag gi dbang du byas par bsam pa ni mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin la brten pa'i zab khyad do// bzlas pa'i mjug tu gang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ de dag ni bskyed rim mo// de nas nye bar bsdu ba ni/

rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang nyid gdan dang bcas pa snying ga'i mkha' 'gro ma la/ de sngags phreng la/ de thig le la/ de hūm̐ yig la/ de yang nā da'i bar du thim/ de yang 'od du yal ba'i ngang la ci tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par 'jog bzhag pa'i ngang la rig pa de rig stong*/ 'gyu ba de 'gyu stong*/ ma sgrib par gsal ba de gsal stong*/ yin min gyi mtha' dang bral bar rmi lam gyi snang ba/ sgyu ma'i rang bzhin zhes ngo sprod pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// zhes shangs pa du gu pa bzhed do// slar yang de'i ngang nas lha yi skur ldangs la gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ram/ gnas gsum bsrung zhing dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /yid bzhin nor bu 'grub gyur nas sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam bya/ thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul na/ gtor ma dpal bshos sam yang na zlum gtor dkar po mtheb kyus bskor ba la/ rtse mor mgon po'i tsakli dang*/ mar gyi nor bu'i gzugs sogs rgyan ldan/ mtheb kyu brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bskor ba/ bu ram sogs zas snas bkang ba/ g.yas su mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang*/ g.yon du gzhi bdag gtor ma/ rgyab tu gnod sbyin gyi gtor ma/ mdun du nyer spyod bcas bshams la/ gtor ma nang mchod chu gtsang gis bran la/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ kam̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ bh+rūm̐ ām̐ḥdz+rīṃ kham̐ hūm̐ las ye shes lnga rnams mes gdungs te bskol zhing zhu ba las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum brjod/ bsdu na sngags 'di kho nas byin rlabs byas kyang rung ngo*// mdun bskyed rgyas pa ni/

swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ dngul chu dwangs pa'i mdog lta bu/ de yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu sogs nas gnyis su med par thim pa'i bar 'dra bar byas/ bsdu na skad cig gis spyan drangs/ gtor sngags rtsa sngags 'bru bcu gsum pa la i daṃ ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa gsum mam lngas phul/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos pad dkar 'chang*// 'gro 'di'i phun tshogs re ba skong ba'i phyir// rab brjid khro bo'i dbang por sprul pa la// yid bzhin nor bur mtshan gsol khyod phyag 'tshal// dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// bstan pa bsrung zhing rnal 'byor pa'i// tshe srings longs spyod rgyas pa dang*// skye 'gro dbang du 'du bar mdzod// ces dang spro na/ bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin gzi ldan thugs rje can khyod la gsol ba 'debs so// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung shig dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod cig dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs shig bla ma'i sku tshe srings shig rnal 'byor bdag la snyan pa'i grags pas sa steng ma lus par khyab pa dang*/ dgos 'dod thams cad char bzhin du babs nas/ longs spyod zad mi shes pa dang mi nor zas gsum 'du zhing*/ thos bsam sgom gsum 'phel ba dang*/ phrin las 'bad med du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa 'di ni bdag mdun gang yin gyi skabs su'ang 'dis gsol ba gdab pa ni gnad do gsungs so// de nas rten la brtan bzhugs byas nas gnas bsrung dge ba bsngo ba bkra shis gang shes bya'o// gong gi nyer bsdu zhes pa'i rdzogs rim skabs 'dir bsgom kyang rung bas gang mos bya'o// spyod lam gyi gnas skabs kun tu snang grags rig gsum thams cad lha sngags ye shes kyi rnam rol du shes pa'i dran pa ma brjed par bya ba gal che/

'grub pa'i rtags dang yon tan thams cad ni mi bslu bar 'byung ba ni nges pa nyid do// mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ stegs bu rten khebs la sogs pas bkab par me tog gi sil ma bkram pa'i steng du/ 'di'i gtor ma zan dras zlum po'i steng du nor bu mig gsum pa'i steng dzaṃ bshos kyi dbyibs can la mar gyi rtse rgyan nyi zla nor bu la sogs pas brgyan pa dar dkar gyi gur dang ldan pa bzhag de'i mdun du 'bul gtor zlum po gnyis dang chu gnyis sngon 'gro nyer spyod rnams bsham/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu nang mchod sogs 'og tu mkho ba'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med par bya'o// gnyis pa ni mchod pa rnams/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil sogs nas oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang*/ dhar+m+ma ra ṇi rol mo bcas pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas bzung ste bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i mjug tu gang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa'i bar gong ltar nyams su blang ngo*// de nas mdun gyi gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ dkar po dngul chu dwangs pa'i mdog lta bu/ de yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu sogs nas gnyis su med par thim pa'i bar gyis gtor ma mgon dkar du bskyed/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngar bzhin byas la/ oṃ gu ru ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra re re sngon 'gro'i ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/ rtsa sngags la 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos sogs kyis bstod/

'bul gtor sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'am bsdu na/ 'bru gsum lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la thal mo sbyar ba kha phye ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas te gong ltar phul la mchod bstod dang gsol gdab ji ltar rigs pa bya/ gtor ma gnyis pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar dbul lo// de nas slob ma rnams khru byas gral la 'khod pa la/ me tog bkye bsdu byas nas slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal 'debs ji ltar rigs pa bya/ 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i zab chos rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje'i zlos gar/ myur mdzad mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu phyag drug pa ste/ de la zhi ba nor du sgrub pa dang drag po mthu ru sgrub pa ste gnyis las/ 'di nyid snga ma ste de'ang gnas skabs su chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa stsol zhing dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal las skyob pa dang*/ mthar thug bla na med pa'i go 'phang bde blag tu ster ba'i gdams pa khyad par can grub chen rā hu las mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la man ngag sgo skyel gyi tshul du gnang ba'i mgon dkar yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rjes su gnang ba ste/ de'ang sngon gyi lo rgyus kyi dbang du byas na/ bla ma mai tri pa ko sa bhik+ṣi'i dur khrod na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ grub chen rā hu las gser srang bdun phul nas/ bod 'dir longs spyod chung bas/ nor sgrub myur la rtags mtshan che ba'i gdams pa zhig zhu zhus pas/ mai tri pas zhal nas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i mgon po zhes kyang bya/ shing phung can zhes kyang bya/ tsan+dan gyi mgon po zhes kyang bya/ thugs rje chen po nag po zhes kyang bya/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa zhes kyang bya ba 'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa/ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud/ mi nor zas gsum shugs las 'byung*/

dgra bgegs thams cad rdul du brlag par byed pa la bzlog pas mi tshugs pa/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub lo zlas 'grub pa/ mchog bsgrubs pa'i thun mong zhar las 'byung ba/ thun mong bsgrubs pa'i mchog zhar las 'byung ba cig yod pa de khyod la sbyin gsungs so// de bla ma la zhu byas pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas mgon po 'dis thugs bskyed pa'i tshul gsungs pa/ sngon gyi dus su sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi spyan sngar thugs rje chen po'i sems bskyed de/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di stongs par ma gyur bar du bdag mya ngan las mi 'da' bar sems can gyi don byed par gyur cig gal te bdag sems bskyed 'di nyams par gyuran mgo bo tshal ba stong du 'gas par gyur cig ces brjod nas dam bcas te/ ri bo po ta lar nyin mtshan dus drug tu sems can rnams la ye shes kyi gzigs pa 'jug cing gang la gang 'dul gyis lo grangs dpag tu med par sems can gyi don byas te mthar sems can gyi khams phal cher grol ba byung bas che snyam nas gzigs pas/ sems can gyi khams la 'grib pa med pa'i steng du/ snyigs mar song bas nyon mongs pa rags pa gdug pa cher song ba gzigs pa dang*/ da ni bdag gis sems can re 'ga' tsam yang bsgral bar mi nus par 'dug snyam nas/ sems bskyed btang ba dang dbu tshal pa stong du gas par gyur to// de'i tshe sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas byon nas/ rigs kyi bu de lta bu'i sems bskyed las gzhol ba ni shin tu ma legs pas de'i bshags pa la sngar las rgya che ba zhig gi sems bskyed cig gsungs nas/ dbu tshal pa stong du gas pa dbu bcu dang*/ de'i gong du sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa'i dbu yod pa dang bcas pa'i zhal bcu gcig tu byin gyis brlabs so// de'i tshe thugs rje chen po 'di snyam du sems te/ da ltar gyi sems bskyed de'i cha gcig kyang ngas ma nus/

de bas rgya che ba zhig kyang med na ji ltar bgyi snyam nas zhag bdun brgyal bar gyur to// de nas brgyal ba de sangs pa dang*/ da ni snyigs ma'i sems can tshe thung la bar chad mang ba/ rkyen dbang 'ba' zhig tu 'gro ba/ longs spyod chung zhing 'tsho ba dman pa/ sgrub long med par bar chad kyi dbang du 'gro ba/ dam tshig mi bsrung zhing bzlog pa dang nang dme byed pa/ chos byed phal cher yang bar do'i 'jigs pa las mi thar bar gzigs nas/ yun ring por bsgrub mi dgos par zhal mthong ba/ gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis 'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob pa/ mi nor zas gsum shugs las 'byung ba/ bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad skad cig gis brlag par byed pa/ mchog dang thun mong lo zlas 'grub pa'i dbang gi rgyal po lta bu'i khro bor gyur nas sems can gyi don bya'o snyam du dgongs te/ thugs ka nas hūm̐ mthing nag gcig phyung*/ de las ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ skye 'gro'i re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bur gyur pa dang sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos so// de'i tshe sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa mgrin gcig tu bsdebs te/ rigs kyi bu sems can re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba'i spyod pa 'di shin tu legs so// sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed pos phrin las 'di nyid mthu dang ldan par bya'o// gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dbang gi rang bzhin gyis dbang dang ldan par bya'o// de nyid kyis zhi ba dang rgyas par yang 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas kyi phrin las su sprul pa las byung ba'i gnod sbyin dang gshin rje dang srin po dang*/ ma mo dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang las sna tshogs bsgrub par 'gyur ro// de nyid tshul bzhin du bsgrub pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/

dran pas dngos grub ma lus pa ster bar 'gyur ro// bsgrub pa nyid nas byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ de nyid kyis dngos su zhal ston par 'gyur ro// zhes lung bstan byin gyis brlabs shing bka' bsgo ba mdzad do// des na ye shes kyi mgon po 'di nyid bsgrubs pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub gcig car du stsol bas khyad par 'phags shing byin rlabs dngos grub shin tu myur ba yin pas yid ches pa'i gnas su mdzad 'tshal/ lo rgyus 'di dag mi spro na ma brjod kyang chog de la slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa/ slob dpon la mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu dngos yin snyam pas rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon tu maṇ+ḍal dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i mgon po yid bzhin nor bu la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs kyi rjes zlos lan gsum bya ba rnams sngon 'gro yin/ rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pas slob dpon mgon dkar du gsal ba'i sku las 'od zer 'phros pas/ khyed rnams kyi lus la phog pas/ sdig sgrib dang rnam smin gdos bcas kyi phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de nyid la dmigs te slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rnams kyi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hūm̐ dkar po dngul chu dwangs ba'i mdog lta bu/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das mgon po yid bzhin nor bu zhes pa nas thig le dmar po 'od 'phro ba zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin gsal gdab/

de nas dngos gzhi sku'i rjes gnang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi gtor ma gnyis ka mgon dkar du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal na bzhugs pa'i thugs kar phog pas/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bka' dang dam tshig rjes su dran pa'i dbang gis mgon po yid bzhin nor bu nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ skad cig thang cig yud tsam la mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas 'dir byon/ de rnams las de 'dra ba'i sku dpag tu med pa chad/ khyed rang rnams mgon dkar du gsal ba'i sku lus la sib kyis thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod ces dang*/ gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dzaḥ.ā be sha ya āḥzhes lan gsum mam lnga brjod cing rol chen bya zhing gu gul gyis bdug de ni sku'i rjes su gnang ba yin/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pas slob dpon mdun bskyed gnyis ka mgon dkar du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad yi ge a ā i ī nas aṃ aḥzhes pa'i ā li dang*/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha zhes pa nas ha k+ṣaḥzhes pa'i kā li dang*/ khyad par ye shes mgon po'i gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad chos skyong spyi'i sngags oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na sogs nas hūm̐ phaṭa ces dang*/ mgon dkar 'di nyid kyi sngags gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dzaḥzhes pa'i sngags phreng kha dog dkar po rang sgra sgrogs bzhin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang ba 'ur 'ur thib thib byung nas khyed rang rnams mgon dkar du gsal ba'i mgrin pa nas sib kyis thim/ gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ gu ru ma hā kā la sogs sngar bzhin brjod cing rol chen dang spos dud bya/

de ni gsung gi rjes su gnang ba yin/ thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pas slob dpon dang mdun bskyed gnyis ka mgon dkar du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*/ khyad par ye shes mgon po'i thugs kyi byin rlabs dang nus pa thams cad rnam pa gri gug dang yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ ḍa ma ru dang*/ thod pa'i phreng ba la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang ba 'ur 'ur thib thib byung nas mdun gyi nam mkhar gnas pa la sems cher gyis gtad pas de rnams 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam par zhu nas/ khyed rang rnams mgon dkar du gsal ba'i snying ga nas sib kyis thim pas thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod ces dang*/ sngags sngar bzhin brjod cing rol chen dang spos dud bya/ de ni thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba yin// yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon mgon dkar du gsal ba dang mdun bskyed kyi mgon dkar gnyis ka'i spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba/ gsang gnas rnams su dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas lcags kyu g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs ling nge ba spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig hrig gzigs pa re lam gyis gsal btab pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi sku las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams kyi zas nor bcud g.yang la sogs pa'i dngos grub thams cad 'ub kyis bsdus nas khyed rang rnams la sib kyis thim pa'i mos pa mdzod ces dang sngags sngar bzhin brjod cing rol chen dang spos dud bya/ de nas bzlas lung slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las/

sngags phreng dang po gnyis pa gsum pa rnams chad/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim pas thugs rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod ces dang sngags kyi rjes zlos byar gzhug de ltar rjes zlos byas nas slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog 'thor ba dang bcas te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog de sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi dbu gtsug tu bzhag pas/ sngags kyi dngos grub myur du thob pa'i skal ba can du byas snyam du mos pa mdzod ces dang*/ slob ma'i mgo bor me tog 'thor zhing*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sku gsung thugs/ gsang sngags rigs sngags kyi nus mthu dang byin rlabs thams cad rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la 'jug cing brtan par gyur cig ces brjod/ de nas gtor ma mgon dkar du gsal ba slob ma'i mgo thog tu spyan drangs te bka' bsgo ba ni/ gu ru ma hā kā la nas dzaḥs ma ya sma ra/ sa ma ya ma ti kra ma/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ dpal ldan shā ba ri/ mnga' bdag mai trī pa/ grub thob rā hu la gup+ta badz+ra/ grub thob khyung po rnal 'byor/ rmog lcog pa rin chen brtson 'grus/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa/ gnyen ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston/ mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu/ mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ byang sems sbyin pa bzang po/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po/ mang mkhar ba blo gros rgyal mtshan/

pu rang dpal ldan dar po/ zhi dgon rje bsod nams rtse mo/ lo chen dam pa 'gyur med bde chen/ mkhas grub ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhas mchog bkra shis dpal ldan/ khams ston sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ rdo rje slob ma rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams la 'go zhing 'ches pa dang*/ bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba bar mdzad du gsol/ 'di rnams kyis dam pa'i chos sgrub par byed pa'i dus su 'tsho ba'i yo byad thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dang snyan grags dang lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rnams gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ de ltar bsgom pas khyed rang gi spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i mgon dkar 'od du ltem gyis zhu ba la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas gnyis su med par thim nas mgon po lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs te rtag tu srung skyob mdzad pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ rjes gtso bos sogs dang maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas spyi dang 'dra/ 'bul gtor steng du 'bul/ yig brgya lan gsum brjod cing ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ mdun bskyed rang la bstims nas dge rtsa sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo'o// smras pa/ 'phags yul rin chen gling du rā hu las// gdams ngag 'dod 'byung nor bu legs blangs nas// gangs can bstan 'gro'i dbul ba dbrog slad du// grub dbang khyung po'i thugs gsang dpal ber sbas// yid bzhin nor mchog grub pa'i dbang phyug gi /zhal lung gtsor brten sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas// yi ge yid ches sum ldan khams gsum dpal// yongs 'gugs pad+ma rā ga'i lcags kyu 'di// 'bad pas lhur blangs dge bas stobs bcu pa'i// dgongs pa 'chad mkhas bstan pa 'dzam bu'i gling*// byams bstan ma shar de srid ches bdo bas// ris bral sems can phan par byed gyur cig

/ces mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i yi ge khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba 'di ni chos rje bkra shis dpal bzang po sogs don gnyer dag gis bskul ngor/ 'di skor la bla ma so sos mdzad pa'i lha bskyed dur khrod rgyan chas sogs phyag drug nag po'i par bkab kyi spros pa mang du mchis mod/ mkhas grub khyung pos mdzad pa'i gzhung dri ma med pa nyid gtsor bzung*/ de dang mthun shas che ba mkhan chen ngag chos pa dang bstan 'dzin phrin las pa sogs mkhas grub mang po'i gsung rab dang rjes gnang gi phyag len gang las mnos pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas nyams su bstar bde bar ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu sbyar ba 'gro ba thams cad la phan par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
